"""UI tab for customer aliases — reconciliation name mappings.

Позволяет бухгалтерам вручную указывать соответствия между заказчиками
со стороны кураторов (master) и заказчиками со стороны РСЧ. Эти алиасы
используются сверкой: при точном совпадении суммы + исполнителя + имени
заказчика (или алиаса) строка получает статус "сверено".
"""

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class AliasesTab:
    """Tab widget for managing customer aliases.

    Shows a sortable table of all aliases with add/edit/delete buttons.
    Double-click a row to edit. Changes take effect immediately on the
    next reconciliation run.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent: ttk.Frame, app_controller) -> None:
        self.parent = parent
        self.app = app_controller
        self._editing: dict | None = None
        self._setup_ui()
        self.refresh()

    def _setup_ui(self) -> None:
        # Header
        header = ttk.Frame(self.parent, style="Main.TFrame")
        header.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 8))
        ttk.Label(
            header,
            text="🔗 Соответствия заказчиков для сверки",
            style="Header.TLabel",
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        ttk.Label(
            header,
            text="Бухгалтеры указывают, какой заказчик куратора = какой заказчик РСЧ",
            style="Muted.TLabel",
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(12, 0))

        # Toolbar
        toolbar = ttk.Frame(self.parent, style="Main.TFrame")
        toolbar.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 6))
        ttk.Button(toolbar, text="➕ Добавить", command=self._on_add).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(0, 4))
        ttk.Button(toolbar, text="✏️ Изменить", command=self._on_edit).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4)
        ttk.Button(toolbar, text="🗑️ Удалить", command=self._on_delete).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4)
        ttk.Button(toolbar, text="🔄 Обновить", command=self.refresh).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4)
        ttk.Label(
            toolbar,
            text="Двойной клик по строке — изменить",
            style="Muted.TLabel",
        ).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)

        # Treeview
        tree_frame = ttk.Frame(self.parent, style="Main.TFrame")
        tree_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        columns = ("id", "master", "rsch", "notes", "updated")
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(
            tree_frame,
            columns=columns,
            show="headings",
            selectmode="browse",
        )
        self.tree.heading("id", text="ID")
        self.tree.heading("master", text="Заказчик (куратор)")
        self.tree.heading("rsch", text="Заказчик (РСЧ)")
        self.tree.heading("notes", text="Заметки")
        self.tree.heading("updated", text="Обновлено")
        self.tree.column("id", width=50, stretch=False)
        self.tree.column("master", width=300, stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("rsch", width=300, stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("notes", width=200, stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("updated", width=140, stretch=False)
        self.tree.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        vsb = ttk.Scrollbar(tree_frame, orient="vertical", command=self.tree.yview)
        vsb.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ns")
        hsb = ttk.Scrollbar(tree_frame, orient="horizontal", command=self.tree.xview)
        hsb.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew")
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=vsb.set, xscrollcommand=hsb.set)
        tree_frame.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
        tree_frame.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.tree.bind("<Double-1>", lambda e: self._on_edit())

        # Footer hint
        ttk.Label(
            self.parent,
            text="ℹ️ Сверено = точное совпадение суммы + исполнителя + заказчика (или алиаса). "
                 "Строки с частичным совпадением попадают в «Проверить» — добавьте алиас, чтобы "
                 "в следующий раз они сверялись автоматически.",
            style="Muted.TLabel",
            wraplength=900,
            justify=tk.LEFT,
        ).pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(8, 0))

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Reload aliases from DB into the treeview."""
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)
        try:
            aliases = self.app.get_customer_aliases()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("Failed to load aliases: %s", e)
            messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", f"Не удалось загрузить алиасы: {e}", parent=self.parent)
            return
        for a in aliases:
            updated = (a.updated_at or "")[:19]
            self.tree.insert(
                "",
                tk.END,
                values=(a.id, a.master_customer, a.rsch_customer, a.notes, updated),
            )

    def _selected_id(self) -> int | None:
        sel = self.tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            return None
        values = self.tree.item(sel[0], "values")
        return int(values[0]) if values else None

    def _on_add(self) -> None:
        self._open_dialog(mode="add")

    def _on_edit(self) -> None:
        sel = self.tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            messagebox.showinfo("Изменение", "Выберите строку для изменения", parent=self.parent)
            return
        values = self.tree.item(sel[0], "values")
        self._open_dialog(
            mode="edit",
            alias_id=int(values[0]),
            master=str(values[1]),
            rsch=str(values[2]),
            notes=str(values[3]) if values[3] else "",
        )

    def _on_delete(self) -> None:
        alias_id = self._selected_id()
        if alias_id is None:
            messagebox.showinfo("Удаление", "Выберите строку для удаления", parent=self.parent)
            return
        if messagebox.askyesno(
            "Удаление алиаса",
            "Удалить выбранный алиас?",
            parent=self.parent,
        ):
            try:
                self.app.delete_customer_alias(alias_id)
                self.refresh()
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", str(e), parent=self.parent)

    def _open_dialog(
        self,
        mode: str,
        alias_id: int | None = None,
        master: str = "",
        rsch: str = "",
        notes: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        dlg = tk.Toplevel(self.parent)
        dlg.title("Добавить алиас" if mode == "add" else "Изменить алиас")
        dlg.geometry("780x280")
        dlg.minsize(640, 240)
        dlg.transient(self.parent)
        dlg.grab_set()

        # Колонка полей ввода и строка заметок растягиваются вместе с окном.
        dlg.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        dlg.rowconfigure(2, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(dlg, text="Заказчик со стороны куратора:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", padx=8, pady=(12, 4))
        master_entry = ttk.Entry(dlg)
        master_entry.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=8, pady=(12, 4))
        master_entry.insert(0, master)

        ttk.Label(dlg, text="Заказчик со стороны РСЧ:").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", padx=8, pady=4)
        rsch_entry = ttk.Entry(dlg)
        rsch_entry.grid(row=1, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=8, pady=4)
        rsch_entry.insert(0, rsch)

        ttk.Label(dlg, text="Заметки:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="nw", padx=8, pady=4)
        notes_entry = tk.Text(dlg, height=3, wrap=tk.WORD)
        notes_entry.grid(row=2, column=1, sticky="nsew", padx=8, pady=4)
        notes_entry.insert("1.0", notes)

        btn_frame = ttk.Frame(dlg)
        btn_frame.grid(row=3, column=0, columnspan=2, pady=(12, 8))

        def save() -> None:
            m = master_entry.get().strip()
            r = rsch_entry.get().strip()
            n = notes_entry.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
            if not m or not r:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", "Заполните оба поля заказчиков", parent=dlg)
                return
            try:
                if mode == "add":
                    self.app.add_customer_alias(m, r, n)
                else:
                    self.app.update_customer_alias(alias_id, m, r, n)
                self.refresh()
                dlg.destroy()
            except ValueError as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", str(e), parent=dlg)
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", f"Не удалось сохранить: {e}", parent=dlg)

        ok_btn = ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Сохранить", command=save)
        ok_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4)
        ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Отмена", command=dlg.destroy).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4)

        # Контекстное меню (правый клик): Вырезать/Копировать/Вставить/Выделить всё.
        def _send_event(virtual_event: str) -> None:
            widget = dlg.focus_get()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.event_generate(virtual_event)

        ctx = tk.Menu(dlg, tearoff=0)
        ctx.add_command(label="Вырезать", command=lambda: _send_event("<<Cut>>"))
        ctx.add_command(label="Копировать", command=lambda: _send_event("<<Copy>>"))
        ctx.add_command(label="Вставить", command=lambda: _send_event("<<Paste>>"))
        ctx.add_separator()
        ctx.add_command(label="Выделить всё", command=lambda: _send_event("<<SelectAll>>"))

        def _show_context_menu(event: tk.Event) -> None:
            ctx.tk_popup(event.x_root, event.y_root)

        for w in (master_entry, rsch_entry, notes_entry):
            w.bind("<Button-3>", _show_context_menu)

        # Горячие клавиши: Enter — сохранить, Escape — отмена.
        def _on_enter(_event: tk.Event) -> None:
            if "disabled" not in ok_btn.state():  # type: ignore[no-untyped-call]
                save()

        dlg.bind("<Return>", _on_enter)
        dlg.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: dlg.destroy())

        dlg.update_idletasks()
        dlg.geometry(f"+{self.parent.winfo_rootx() + 100}+{self.parent.winfo_rooty() + 100}")
        master_entry.focus_set()

    def _setup_aliases(self) -> None:
        from core.ui.ui_aliases import AliasesTab
        app_ctl = getattr(self.controller, "app_controller", self.controller)
        self._aliases_tab = AliasesTab(self.aliases_tab, app_ctl)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self._refresh_reports()
        self._refresh_home()
        self._refresh_logs()
        self._refresh_settings()

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        """Re-apply theme-dependent tag colours after a palette switch."""
        self.results_tree.tag_configure(
            "empty", foreground=_c("text_muted", _c("text", "#6c757d"))
        )

    def run_diagnostics(self) -> None:
        for item in self.diagnostics_tree.get_children():
            self.diagnostics_tree.delete(item)
        for item in run_light_diagnostics(self.config_controller, self.app_root):
            self.diagnostics_tree.insert(
                "",
                tk.END,
                values=(
                    item.label,
                    status_text(item.status),
                    item.detail,
                    str(item.path) if item.path else "",
                ),
            )
        self._refresh_home()

    def copy_diagnostics(self) -> None:
        diagnostics = run_light_diagnostics(
            self.config_controller,
            self.app_root,
            include_network=False,
        )
        log_errors = self._recent_log_errors()
        summary = build_diagnostic_summary(
            diagnostics,
            self._last_results,
            log_errors,
        )
        self.notebook.clipboard_clear()
        self.notebook.clipboard_append(summary)
        messagebox.showinfo("Диагностика", "Диагностика скопирована в буфер обмена")

    def record_result(
        self,
        label: str,
        ok: bool,
        message: str,
        path: Path | None = None,
        rows: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._last_results.insert(
            0,
            RuntimeResult(label, ok, message, path, rows, datetime.now()),
        )
        self._last_results = self._last_results[:10]
        save_runtime_results(self.runtime_state_path, self._last_results)
        self.refresh()

    def _run_in_background(
        self, work: Callable[[], _T], on_done: Callable[[_T], None]
    ) -> None:
        """Run ``work`` on a daemon thread, then call ``on_done`` on the
        GUI thread via ``root.after(0, ...)``.

        Used to keep ``path.exists()`` / network-drive probes off the
        Tk event loop so consolidations do not freeze the UI.
        """

        def runner() -> None:
            try:
                result = work()
            except Exception:
                logging.exception("Background dashboard task failed")
                result = None

            def safe_done() -> None:
                try:
                    on_done(result)
                except tk.TclError:
                    pass

            try:
                self.notebook.after(0, safe_done)
            except tk.TclError:
                pass

        threading.Thread(target=runner, daemon=True).start()

    def _refresh_reports(self) -> None:
        for item in self.reports_tree.get_children():
            self.reports_tree.delete(item)
        self.reports_tree.insert("", tk.END, values=("проверка...", "", "", "", ""))

        def work():
            return collect_report_paths(self.config_controller, self.app_root)

        def done(payload):
            if payload is None:
                return
            for item in self.reports_tree.get_children():
                self.reports_tree.delete(item)
            for item in payload:
                status = "найден" if item.exists else "не найден"
                self.reports_tree.insert(
                    "",
                    tk.END,
                    values=(
                        item.label,
                        f"✅ {status}" if item.exists else f"⚠️ {status}",
                        item.mtime,
                        item.size,
                        str(item.path) if item.path else "",
                    ),
                )

        self._run_in_background(work, done)

    def _refresh_home(self) -> None:
        self.state_label.config(text="проверка...")

        def work():
            diagnostics = run_light_diagnostics(self.config_controller, self.app_root)
            reports = collect_report_paths(self.config_controller, self.app_root)
            return diagnostics, reports

        def done(payload):
            if payload is None:
                return
            diagnostics, reports = payload
            errors = sum(1 for item in diagnostics if item.status == "error")
            warnings = sum(1 for item in diagnostics if item.status == "warning")
            existing_reports = sum(1 for item in reports if item.exists)
            self.state_label.config(
                text=(
                    f"Готовность: {'можно работать' if errors == 0 else 'есть ошибки'}\n"
                    f"Диагностика: ошибок {errors}, предупреждений {warnings}\n"
                    f"Найдено результатов: {existing_reports}/{len(reports)}"
                )
            )

            for item in self.results_tree.get_children():
                self.results_tree.delete(item)
            if not self._last_results:
                # Empty-state hint so the tree isn't a blank grid on
                # first launch (before any consolidation has run).
                self.results_tree.insert(
                    "",
                    tk.END,
                    values=(
                        "Нет данных",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "",
                        "Запустите сборку отчета",
                    ),
                    tags=("empty",),
                )
                return
            for result in self._last_results:
                time_text = result.created_at.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M") if result.created_at else "-"
                message = result.message
                if result.rows is not None:
                    message = f"{message} | строк: {result.rows}"
                self.results_tree.insert(
                    "",
                    tk.END,
                    values=(
                        result.label,
                        "✅ успех" if result.ok else "❌ ошибка",
                        time_text,
                        str(result.path) if result.path else "",
                        message,
                    ),
                )

        self._run_in_background(work, done)

    def _refresh_logs(self) -> None:
        logs = read_recent_logs(
            [self.app_root / "startup_log.txt", self.repo_root / "gui_error_log.txt"],
            limit=150
        )
        self.log_errors.configure(state="normal")
        self.log_errors.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        if logs:
            self.log_errors.insert(tk.END, "\n".join(logs))
            self.log_errors.see(tk.END)
        else:
            self.log_errors.insert(tk.END, "Событий в логах не найдено.")
        self.log_errors.configure(state="disabled")

    def _refresh_settings(self) -> None:
        # 1. Загрузка в YAML-редактор
        self.settings_text.configure(state="normal")
        self.settings_text.delete("1.0", tk.END)
        config_path = Path(self.config_controller.config_path)
        if config_path.exists():
            try:
                text = config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.settings_text.insert(tk.END, text)
            except Exception as e:
                self.settings_text.insert(tk.END, f"# Ошибка чтения файла настроек: {e}")
        else:
            self.settings_text.insert(tk.END, "# Файл config.yaml не найден.")
        
        # 2. Загрузка в визуальную форму
        cfg = self.config_controller.config
        paths_cfg = cfg.get("paths", {})
        
        self.master_file_var.set(paths_cfg.get("master_file", ""))
        self.archive_dir_var.set(paths_cfg.get("archive_dir", ""))
        
        # Загрузка списка источников
        self.sources_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        source_roots = paths_cfg.get("source_roots", [])
        if isinstance(source_roots, list):
            for root in source_roots:
                self.sources_listbox.insert(tk.END, str(root))
                
        # Сетевые диски
        network_cfg = cfg.get("network", {})
        drive_letters = network_cfg.get("drive_letters", [])
        if isinstance(drive_letters, list):
            self.drive_letters_var.set(", ".join(str(d) for d in drive_letters))
        else:
            self.drive_letters_var.set(str(drive_letters))
            
        # Число бэкапов
        backup_cfg = cfg.get("backup", {})
        self.excel_keep_var.set(backup_cfg.get("excel_keep", 10))

    def _save_settings(self) -> None:
        config_path = Path(self.config_controller.config_path)
        from ruamel.yaml import YAML
        yaml = YAML()
        
        if self.settings_mode == "yaml":
            # Сохранение в режиме YAML-кода
            text = self.settings_text.get("1.0", tk.END)
            try:
                parsed = yaml.load(text)
                if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
                    raise ValueError("Корневой элемент конфигурации должен быть объектом (словарем)")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка сохранения", f"Некорректный синтаксис YAML:\n{e}")
                return
                
            try:
                config_path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
                self.config_controller.config = parsed
                messagebox.showinfo("Успех", "Настройки успешно сохранены!")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка сохранения", f"Не удалось записать файл config.yaml:\n{e}")
        else:
            # Сохранение из визуальной формы
            cfg = self.config_controller.config
            
            if "paths" not in cfg:
                cfg["paths"] = {}
            if "network" not in cfg:
                cfg["network"] = {}
            if "backup" not in cfg:
                cfg["backup"] = {}
                
            cfg["paths"]["master_file"] = self.master_file_var.get()
            cfg["paths"]["archive_dir"] = self.archive_dir_var.get()
            
            roots = list(self.sources_listbox.get(0, tk.END))
            cfg["paths"]["source_roots"] = roots
            
            drives_str = self.drive_letters_var.get()
            drives = [d.strip().upper() for d in drives_str.split(",") if d.strip()]
            cfg["network"]["drive_letters"] = drives
            
            try:
                keep = int(self.excel_keep_var.get())
                cfg["backup"]["excel_keep"] = keep
            except (ValueError, tk.TclError):
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка сохранения", "Количество бэкапов должно быть целым числом!")
                return
                
            try:
                self.config_controller.save_config()
                self._refresh_settings()
                messagebox.showinfo("Успех", "Настройки успешно сохранены!")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Ошибка сохранения", f"Не удалось сохранить настройки:\n{e}")

    def _toggle_settings_mode(self) -> None:
        if self.settings_mode == "visual":
            self.settings_mode = "yaml"
            self.mode_btn.configure(text="Визуальный режим")
            self.settings_visual_frame.pack_forget()
            self._refresh_settings()
            self.settings_yaml_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        else:
            self.settings_mode = "visual"
            self.mode_btn.configure(text="Режим YAML-кода")
            self.settings_yaml_frame.pack_forget()
            self._refresh_settings()
            self.settings_visual_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

    def _browse_master_file(self) -> None:
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Выберите основной сводный отчет",
            filetypes=[("Excel Files", "*.xlsx;*.xlsb"), ("All Files", "*.*")]
        )
        if path:
            try:
                rel_path = Path(path).relative_to(self.repo_root)
                self.master_file_var.set(str(Path("..") / rel_path))
            except ValueError:
                self.master_file_var.set(path)

    def _browse_archive_dir(self) -> None:
        path = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Выберите папку для резервных копий")
        if path:
            try:
                rel_path = Path(path).relative_to(self.repo_root)
                self.archive_dir_var.set(str(Path("..") / rel_path))
            except ValueError:
                self.archive_dir_var.set(path)

    def _add_source_root(self) -> None:
        path = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Выберите папку с отчетами кураторов")
        if path:
            self.sources_listbox.insert(tk.END, path)

    def _remove_source_root(self) -> None:
        selected = self.sources_listbox.curselection()
        if selected:
            self.sources_listbox.delete(selected[0])

    def _selected_report_path(self) -> Path | None:
        selected = self.reports_tree.selection()
        if not selected:
            return None
        values = self.reports_tree.item(selected[0])["values"]
        if len(values) < 5 or not values[4]:
            return None
        return Path(str(values[4]))

    def _selected_result_path(self) -> Path | None:
        selected = self.results_tree.selection()
        if not selected:
            return None
        values = self.results_tree.item(selected[0])["values"]
        if len(values) < 4 or not values[3]:
            return None
        return Path(str(values[3]))

    def _open_selected_report(self) -> None:
        self._open_path(self._selected_report_path())

    def _open_selected_report_folder(self) -> None:
        path = self._selected_report_path()
        if path and path.is_file():
            path = path.parent
        self._open_path(path)

    def _open_selected_result(self) -> None:
        self._open_path(self._selected_result_path())

    def _open_backup_folder(self) -> None:
        for item in collect_report_paths(self.config_controller, self.app_root):
            if item.label == "Backup":
                self._open_path(item.path)
                return
        self._show_missing("Backup-папка не настроена")

    def _open_report_by_label(self, label: str) -> None:
        for item in collect_report_paths(self.config_controller, self.app_root):
            if item.label == label:
                self._open_path(item.path)
                return
        self._show_missing(f"Путь не найден: {label}")

    def _recent_log_errors(self) -> list[str]:
        return read_recent_log_errors(
            [self.repo_root / "startup_log.txt", self.repo_root / "gui_error_log.txt"]
        )

    def _open_path(self, path: Path | None) -> None:
        safe_open_existing_path(path, open_path, self._show_missing)

    def _show_missing(self, message: str) -> None:
        messagebox.showwarning("Путь не найден", message)

import os
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, List, Optional


def show_multi_file_select_dialog(
    parent,
    initial_paths: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    title: str = "Выберите файлы",
    filetypes: Optional[List[tuple]] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    """Modal dialog for selecting multiple files with a live preview.

    Replaces the previous *askopenfilenames → askyesno → loop* pattern:
    the user adds files via the file picker one or more times, sees
    a live list of name/size/mtime, can remove individual entries,
    and confirms with a single click.  The dialog is empty until at
    least one file has been added; cancelling returns the original
    list (so the user can re-open and keep working with it).
    """
    if filetypes is None:
        filetypes = [("Excel files", "*.xlsx *.xlsm *.xlsb"), ("All files", "*.*")]

    dialog = tk.Toplevel(parent)
    dialog.title(title)
    dialog.geometry("800x500")
    dialog.minsize(480, 280)
    dialog.transient(parent)
    dialog.grab_set()

    _title_label = ttk.Label(
        dialog, text=f"{title} — выбрано: 0", padding=(10, 10, 10, 0)
    )
    _title_label.pack(anchor=tk.W)

    list_frame = ttk.Frame(dialog, padding=(10, 4))
    list_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
    tree = ttk.Treeview(
        list_frame,
        columns=("path", "size", "mtime"),
        show="headings",
        height=12,
        selectmode="extended",
    )
    tree.heading("path", text="Путь / файл")
    tree.heading("size", text="Размер")
    tree.heading("mtime", text="Изменён")
    tree.column("path", width=360, anchor=tk.W)
    tree.column("size", width=80, anchor=tk.E)
    tree.column("mtime", width=130, anchor=tk.W)
    tree.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
    scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(list_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=tree.yview)
    scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
    tree.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)

    def _format_size(n: int) -> str:
        for unit in ("Б", "КБ", "МБ", "ГБ"):
            if n < 1024:
                return f"{n:.0f} {unit}" if unit == "Б" else f"{n:.1f} {unit}"
            n /= 1024
        return f"{n:.1f} ТБ"

    def _refresh(paths: List[str]) -> None:
        for row in tree.get_children():
            tree.delete(row)
        for p in paths:
            pp = Path(p)
            display_path = str(pp.parent)
            try:
                st = os.stat(p)
                size = _format_size(st.st_size)
                mtime = (
                    Path(p)
                    .stat()
                    .st_mtime
                )
                from datetime import datetime
                mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime).strftime(
                    "%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"
                )
                value_path = f"{display_path}\\{pp.name}"
                tree.insert("", tk.END, iid=p, values=(value_path, size, mtime_str))
            except OSError:
                tree.insert(
                    "", tk.END, iid=p,
                    values=(f"{display_path}\\{pp.name} (нет доступа)", "-", "-"),
                )
        _title_label.configure(text=f"{title} — выбрано: {len(paths)}")

    selected: List[str] = list(initial_paths or [])
    _refresh(selected)

    def _add() -> None:
        initial_dir = None
        if selected:
            initial_dir = str(Path(selected[0]).parent)
        new = filedialog.askopenfilenames(
            title="Добавить файлы",
            filetypes=filetypes,
            initialdir=initial_dir,
        )
        if not new:
            return
        seen = set(selected)
        for p in new:
            if p not in seen:
                selected.append(p)
                seen.add(p)
        _refresh(selected)

    def _remove() -> None:
        for iid in tree.selection():
            if iid in selected:
                selected.remove(iid)
        _refresh(selected)

    def _ok() -> None:
        dialog.destroy()

    def _cancel() -> None:
        # Cancelling reverts to the *original* list — the user can
        # always re-open the dialog and start over without losing
        # what they had staged.
        selected[:] = list(initial_paths or [])
        dialog.destroy()

    btn_frame = ttk.Frame(dialog, padding=10)
    btn_frame.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="➕ Добавить ещё", command=_add).pack(side=tk.LEFT)
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="➖ Удалить", command=_remove).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(5, 0))
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Готово", command=_ok).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Отмена", command=_cancel).pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=5)

    dialog.wait_window()
    return list(selected)


def show_attach_file_dialog(
    parent,
    employees: List[str],
    on_attach: Callable[[str, List[str], bool], None],
    preselect: Optional[str] = None,
):
    dialog = tk.Toplevel(parent)
    dialog.title("Привязать файлы")
    dialog.geometry("450x400")
    dialog.transient(parent)
    dialog.grab_set()

    ttk.Label(dialog, text="Выберите сотрудника:", padding=10).pack()
    employee_var = tk.StringVar()
    employee_combo = ttk.Combobox(
        dialog,
        textvariable=employee_var,
        values=employees,
        # Pre-typed characters narrow the dropdown — Tk's built-in
        # ``postcommand`` filters via the *starts-with* heuristic, which
        # is good enough for ≤100 employees.
    )
    employee_combo.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
    if preselect and preselect in employees:
        # Pre-select the row that was right-clicked on, so the user
        # does not have to re-pick from the dropdown.
        employee_var.set(preselect)
    employee_combo.focus_set()

    selected_files_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(dialog, text="Выбранные файлы", padding=6)
    selected_files_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True, padx=10, pady=5)
    files_listbox = tk.Listbox(selected_files_frame, height=6)
    files_listbox.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

    append_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
    ttk.Checkbutton(dialog, text="Добавить к существующим", variable=append_var).pack(pady=5)

    def pick_files() -> None:
        paths = filedialog.askopenfilenames(title="Файлы для привязки")
        for p in paths:
            files_listbox.insert(tk.END, p)

    def pick() -> None:
        emp_name = employee_var.get().strip()
        if not emp_name:
            return
        files = list(files_listbox.get(0, tk.END))
        if not files:
            # No files staged yet — open the picker once before bailing.
            paths = filedialog.askopenfilenames(
                title=f"Файлы для {emp_name}"
            )
            files = list(paths)
        if not files:
            return
        on_attach(emp_name, files, append_var.get())
        dialog.destroy()

    btn_frame = ttk.Frame(dialog, padding=10)
    btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X)
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Выбрать файлы", command=pick_files).pack(side=tk.LEFT)
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Привязать", command=pick).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)
    ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Отмена", command=dialog.destroy).pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=5)


def ask_employee_name(existing_names: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> str:
    """Open a custom Add-Employee dialog with realtime validation.

    The dialog is modal, gives the user live feedback (red/green
    border + tooltip) on empty/whitespace/duplicate input, and only
    enables the OK button when the name is valid.  The result is
    returned as a stripped string, or ``""`` if the user cancelled.
    """
    existing = {n.strip().lower() for n in (existing_names or []) if n and n.strip()}

    dialog = tk.Toplevel()
    dialog.title("Добавить сотрудника")
    dialog.geometry("380x200")
    dialog.transient(dialog.master)
    dialog.grab_set()
    dialog.resizable(False, False)

    ttk.Label(dialog, text="Имя сотрудника:", padding=(10, 10, 10, 0)).pack(anchor=tk.W)

    name_var = tk.StringVar()
    entry = ttk.Entry(dialog, textvariable=name_var, width=40)
    entry.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=4)
    entry.focus_set()

    status_var = tk.StringVar()
    status_label = ttk.Label(dialog, textvariable=status_var, padding=(10, 0))
    status_label.pack(fill=tk.X)

    btn_frame = ttk.Frame(dialog, padding=10)
    btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X)
    cancel_btn = ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Отмена", command=dialog.destroy)
    cancel_btn.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=(5, 0))
    ok_btn = ttk.Button(btn_frame, text="Добавить", command=dialog.destroy)
    ok_btn.pack(side=tk.RIGHT)
    ok_btn.state(["disabled"])

    result_holder: List[str] = [""]

    def _validate(_event=None) -> None:
        raw = name_var.get()
        name = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            status_var.set("")
            ok_btn.state(["disabled"])
            return
        if not name:
            status_var.set("Имя не может состоять только из пробелов")
            ok_btn.state(["disabled"])
            return
        if name.lower() in existing:
            status_var.set(f"Сотрудник «{name}» уже существует")
            ok_btn.state(["disabled"])
            return
        status_var.set(f"Готово к добавлению: «{name}»")
        ok_btn.state(["!disabled"])

    def _submit() -> None:
        # Only invoked when the OK button is enabled, so the input is
        # already valid by the time we get here.
        result_holder[0] = name_var.get().strip()
        dialog.destroy()

    ok_btn.configure(command=_submit)
    name_var.trace_add("write", lambda *_args: _validate())
    entry.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: _submit() if "disabled" not in ok_btn.state() else None)
    entry.bind("<Escape>", lambda _e: dialog.destroy())

    dialog.wait_window()
    return result_holder[0]

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

from core.ui.debounce import Debouncer
from core.ui.theme import ThemeManager


def _c(key, fallback):
    """Safe theme-color lookup with fallback for keys POLISH-1 may add."""
    return ThemeManager.COLORS.get(key, fallback)


_COLUMN_WEIGHTS = {
    "Employee": 35,
    "Status": 20,
    "Path": 45,
}


class EmployeeTable(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, parent, controller):
        super().__init__(parent, style="Main.TFrame")
        self.controller = controller
        self._search_debouncer = Debouncer(self, self.controller.filter_tree, delay_ms=300)
        # Row index for alternating stripes (reset on clear_tree); and
        # the current hovered item id for hover-row highlight.
        self._row_index = 0
        self._hover_row = None
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        # Header with actions
        header_frame = ttk.Frame(self, style="Main.TFrame")
        header_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 10))

        ttk.Label(header_frame, text="📋 СТАТУС ГОТОВНОСТИ ОТЧЕТОВ", style="Header.TLabel").pack(
            side=tk.LEFT
        )

        btn_frame = ttk.Frame(header_frame, style="Main.TFrame")
        btn_frame.pack(side=tk.RIGHT)

        ttk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="📂 Папка Master", command=self.controller.open_master_folder
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        ttk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="📋 Должники", command=self.controller.copy_missing_to_clipboard
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        # Search
        search_frame = ttk.Frame(self, style="Main.TFrame")
        search_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 5))

        self.search_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.search_var.trace_add("write", lambda *args: self._search_debouncer())

        ttk.Entry(search_frame, textvariable=self.search_var).pack(
            side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True
        )

        # Treeview
        self.tree_frame = ttk.Frame(self)
        self.tree_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(
            self.tree_frame,
            columns=("Employee", "Status", "Path"),
            show="headings",
            selectmode="browse",
        )
        self.tree.heading("Employee", text="Сотрудник")
        self.tree.heading("Status", text="Статус")
        self.tree.heading("Path", text="Файл отчета")

        # All columns stretch proportionally to window width
        self.tree.column("Employee", width=180, stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("Status", width=120, stretch=True)
        self.tree.column("Path", width=250, stretch=True)

        # Bind to frame resize for proportional column distribution
        self.tree_frame.bind("<Configure>", self._resize_columns, add="+")

        # Alternating row stripes + hover highlight (POLISH-3).
        # Status tags ("ready"/"missing"/"partial") get a coloured
        # foreground so the user can scan readiness at a glance.
        self._configure_tags()
        self.tree.bind("<Motion>", self._on_tree_motion, add="+")
        self.tree.bind("<Leave>", self._on_tree_leave, add="+")

        self.tree.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Scrollbar
        scrollbar = ttk.Scrollbar(self.tree_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=scrollbar.set)
        scrollbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        # Context Menu
        self.menu = tk.Menu(self.tree, tearoff=0)
        self.menu.add_command(
            label="📁 Открыть папку", command=self.controller.open_employee_folder
        )
        self.menu.add_command(label="📊 Открыть файл", command=self.controller.open_employee_file)
        self.menu.add_separator()
        self.menu.add_command(
            label="❌ Удалить сотрудника", command=self.controller.delete_employee
        )

        self.tree.bind("<Button-3>", self._show_context_menu)
        self.tree.bind("<Double-1>", lambda e: self.controller.open_employee_file())
        self.bind("<Destroy>", self._on_destroy, add="+")

    def _configure_tags(self) -> None:
        """Apply current theme colours to Treeview row tags.

        Called at init and again on every ``refresh_theme()`` so the
        stripes/status colours follow light↔dark switches.
        """
        self.tree.tag_configure("odd", background=_c("bg_panel", "#f3f4f6"))
        self.tree.tag_configure("even", background=_c("bg_sidebar", "#ffffff"))
        self.tree.tag_configure("hover", background=_c("border_subtle", _c("trough", "#e5e7eb")))
        self.tree.tag_configure("ready", foreground=_c("success", "#28a745"))
        self.tree.tag_configure("missing", foreground=_c("danger", "#dc3545"))

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        """Re-apply theme-dependent tag colours after a palette switch."""
        self._configure_tags()

    def _resize_columns(self, event=None) -> None:
        """Distribute treeview width proportionally across columns.

        Uses the ``_COLUMN_WEIGHTS`` dict (percentages). The scrollbar
        width is subtracted so the distribution matches the visible area.
        """
        try:
            total = self.tree_frame.winfo_width()
            if total < 50:
                return
            # Subtract ~20 px for the scrollbar
            available = total - 20
            for col, weight in _COLUMN_WEIGHTS.items():
                w = max(60, int(available * weight / 100))
                self.tree.column(col, width=w, minwidth=60)
        except (tk.TclError, AttributeError):
            pass

    def _on_destroy(self, _event):
        self._search_debouncer.cancel()

    def _show_context_menu(self, event):
        item = self.tree.identify_row(event.y)
        if item:
            self.tree.selection_set(item)
            self.menu.post(event.x_root, event.y_root)

    def get_search_query(self):
        return self.search_var.get().lower()

    def clear_tree(self):
        self._row_index = 0
        self._hover_row = None
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)

    def insert_row(self, values, tag):
        # Alternate stripe tag (odd/even) is merged with the caller's
        # status tag so both the row background AND the status text
        # colour apply — tags are additive in ttk.Treeview.
        stripe = "odd" if self._row_index % 2 else "even"
        self._row_index += 1
        tags = [stripe]
        if tag:
            tags.append(tag)
        self.tree.insert("", tk.END, values=values, tags=tuple(tags))

    def _on_tree_motion(self, event):
        """Highlight the row under the cursor for visual scanning."""
        row = self.tree.identify_row(event.y)
        if row == self._hover_row:
            return
        if self._hover_row:
            self._strip_hover_tag(self._hover_row)
        if row:
            tags = [t for t in self.tree.item(row, "tags") if t != "hover"]
            tags.append("hover")
            self.tree.item(row, tags=tags)
        self._hover_row = row or None

    def _on_tree_leave(self, _event):
        if self._hover_row:
            self._strip_hover_tag(self._hover_row)
            self._hover_row = None

    def _strip_hover_tag(self, item):
        existing = [t for t in self.tree.item(item, "tags") if t != "hover"]
        self.tree.item(item, tags=existing)

    def get_selected_employee(self):
        sel = self.tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            return None
        return self.tree.item(sel[0])["values"][0]

class LogPanel(ttk.Frame):

        header_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10, 2))

            header_frame,

            header_frame,
            text="🧹 Очистить",
            command=self.clear_logs
        ).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)
        
        self.log_area = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(
            self,
            state='disabled',
            font=ThemeManager.FONTS['mono'],
            borderwidth=1,
            relief='solid',
            bg=ThemeManager.COLORS["bg_panel"],
            fg=ThemeManager.COLORS["text"],
            insertbackground=ThemeManager.COLORS["text"],
            selectbackground=ThemeManager.COLORS["primary"],
            selectforeground=ThemeManager.COLORS["text_inverse"],
        )
        # ScrolledText uses explicit colours that do not follow ttk

        self.log_area.delete('1.0', tk.END)
        self.log_area.configure(state='disabled')

    def append_log(self, message):
        self.log_area.configure(state='normal')
        self.log_area.insert(tk.END, message + '\n')
        self.log_area.configure(state='disabled')
        self.log_area.yview(tk.END)

    def get_widget(self):
        return self.log_area

import sys
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from tkcalendar import DateEntry
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from core.ui.theme import ThemeManager
from core.ui.debounce import Debouncer


def _last_day_of_month(month_start: datetime) -> datetime:
    if month_start.month == 12:
        return month_start.replace(day=31)
    return (month_start.replace(day=28) + timedelta(days=4)).replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=1)


def _previous_month_start(today: datetime) -> datetime:
    if today.month == 1:
        return today.replace(year=today.year - 1, month=12, day=1)
    return today.replace(month=today.month - 1, day=1)


def get_default_period_range(today: datetime | None = None) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    today = today or datetime.now()
    if today.day == 1:
        start = _previous_month_start(today)
        return start, _last_day_of_month(start)

    start = today.replace(day=1)
    return start, today


class Sidebar(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, parent, controller):
        screen_w = parent.winfo_screenwidth()
        sidebar_w = max(260, min(360, int(screen_w * 0.22)))
        super().__init__(parent, width=sidebar_w, padding="4", style="Sidebar.TFrame")
        self.controller = controller
        self.pack_propagate(False)
        # Debounce date changes so clicking through dates in the picker
        # does not fire a full refresh per click.
        self._date_debouncer = Debouncer(self, self.controller.refresh_status, delay_ms=250)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(
            self,
            borderwidth=0,
            highlightthickness=0,
            background=ThemeManager.COLORS["bg_sidebar"],
        )
        # Canvas uses explicit colours (not a ttk style), so register
        # it to be re-themed on ThemeManager.set_theme().
        ThemeManager.register(self.canvas, bg_key="bg_sidebar")
        self.scrollbar = ttk.Scrollbar(self, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.content = ttk.Frame(self.canvas, style="Sidebar.TFrame")
        self._content_window = self.canvas.create_window((0, 0), window=self.content, anchor=tk.NW)
        self.canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=self.scrollbar.set)
        self.canvas.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.scrollbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.content.bind("<Configure>", self._on_content_configure)
        self.canvas.bind("<Configure>", self._on_canvas_configure)
        self.canvas.bind("<Enter>", self._bind_mousewheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<Leave>", self._unbind_mousewheel)
        self._setup_ui()

    def _on_content_configure(self, _event):
        self.canvas.configure(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox("all"))

    def _on_canvas_configure(self, event):
        self.canvas.itemconfigure(self._content_window, width=event.width)

    def _bind_mousewheel(self, _event):
        # Bind on the canvas only — the previous implementation used
        # ``bind_all``, which routed the wheel to every widget while the
        # cursor was over the sidebar (a focus-eating overreach).
        self.canvas.bind("<MouseWheel>", self._on_mousewheel)
        # X11 / Linux use discrete Button-4 (up) and Button-5 (down) for
        # the wheel — ``<MouseWheel>`` does not fire on those platforms.
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-4>", self._on_button4)
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-5>", self._on_button5)

    def _unbind_mousewheel(self, _event):
        self.canvas.unbind("<MouseWheel>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-4>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-5>")

    def _on_mousewheel(self, event):
        # macOS reports delta as ±1 (small integers); Windows uses
        # multiples of 120. ``int(delta / 120)`` truncates to zero on
        # macOS, so use the platform-specific scaling.
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            steps = -event.delta
        else:
            steps = -int(event.delta / 120)
        self.canvas.yview_scroll(steps, "units")

    def _on_button4(self, _event):
        self.canvas.yview_scroll(-1, "units")
        return "break"

    def _on_button5(self, _event):
        self.canvas.yview_scroll(1, "units")
        return "break"

        """Forward the chosen theme to the master controller."""
        value = self.theme_var.get()
        setter = getattr(self.controller, "set_theme", None)
        if callable(setter):
            setter(value)

    def _on_destroy(self, _event):
        # Cancel any pending debounced calls so a fast destroy during
        # the user's date-picking does not fire a stale refresh.
        self._date_debouncer.cancel()

    def _toggle_period_section(self):
        """Expand/collapse the period compilation panel."""
        self._period_expanded = not getattr(self, "_period_expanded", False)
        if self._period_expanded:
            self._per_panel.pack(fill=tk.X, after=self._per_toggle)
            self._per_toggle.configure(text="▼  Свернуть")
        else:
            self._per_panel.pack_forget()
            self._per_toggle.configure(text="▶  Развернуть")

    def _set_current_month(self):
        today = datetime.now()
        self.month_start_entry.set_date(today.replace(day=1))
        self.month_end_entry.set_date(_last_day_of_month(today))

    def _set_previous_month(self):
        today = datetime.now()
        prev_month = _previous_month_start(today)
        self.month_start_entry.set_date(prev_month)
        self.month_end_entry.set_date(_last_day_of_month(prev_month))
        self._validate_period_range()

    def _validate_period_range(self) -> None:
        """Highlight the period DateEntries when end < start.

        The validation is purely visual — the actual guard still lives
        in the build commands, but giving the user immediate feedback
        when the picker shows an inverted range prevents them from
        clicking "СОБРАТЬ ПЕРИОД" only to be told about the error.
        """
        try:
            start = self.month_start_entry.get_date()
            end = self.month_end_entry.get_date()
        except (tk.TclError, ValueError):
            return
        invalid = start > end
        # Tk's ``configure`` does not change border colour on ttk
        # widgets, so we use the surrounding LabelFrame text colour as
        # a soft signal: red when invalid, normal otherwise.
        if invalid == self._range_invalid:
            # No change, but the preset buttons may have just been
            # clicked; nothing to do beyond the early-exit guard.
            return
        self._range_invalid = invalid
        if invalid:
            self.month_start_entry.configure(foreground="#dc3545")
            self.month_end_entry.configure(foreground="#dc3545")
            from core.ui.tooltip import Tooltip

            if self._range_warning_tooltip is None:
                self._range_warning_tooltip = Tooltip(
                    self.month_end_entry,
                    "Дата окончания раньше даты начала. Поменяйте одну из дат.",
                )
            else:
                self._range_warning_tooltip.set_text(
                    "Дата окончания раньше даты начала. Поменяйте одну из дат."
                )
        else:
            self.month_start_entry.configure(foreground="white")
            self.month_end_entry.configure(foreground="white")
            from core.ui.tooltip import Tooltip

            if self._range_warning_tooltip is not None:
                self._range_warning_tooltip.set_text("")

    def get_date(self):
        return self.date_entry.get_date()

    def get_curator(self):
        value = self.curator_var.get()
        if value == "Куратор Борис":
            return "boris"
        if value == "Куратор Иван":
            return "ivan"
        return None

    def get_month_range(self):
        """Возвращает (start_date, end_date) для месячного отчёта."""
        start_date = self.month_start_entry.get_date()
        end_date = self.month_end_entry.get_date()
        today = datetime.now().date()
        if end_date > today:
            end_date = today
        return start_date, end_date

    def set_refresh_state(self, state):
        self.refresh_btn.config(state=state)

    def set_consolidate_state(self, state):
        self.consolidate_btn.config(state=state)

    def set_consolidate_all_state(self, state):
        self.consolidate_all_btn.config(state=state)

    def set_consolidate_month_state(self, state):
        self.consolidate_month_btn.config(state=state)

    def set_rsch_state(self, state):
        self.rsch_btn.config(state=state)
        if hasattr(self, "rsch_month_btn"):
            self.rsch_month_btn.config(state=state)

    def set_reconciliation_state(self, state):
        self.reconciliation_btn.config(state=state)
        self.auto_reconciliation_btn.config(state=state)

    # --- global state ---------------------------------------------------

    _OPERATION_BUTTONS_ATTRS = (
        "refresh_btn",
        "add_employee_btn",
        "attach_btn",
        "consolidate_btn",
        "consolidate_all_btn",
        "consolidate_month_btn",
        "rsch_btn",
        "rsch_month_btn",
        "reconciliation_btn",
        "auto_reconciliation_btn",
    )

    def apply(self, snap) -> None:
        """Apply global operation state to all action widgets.

        When any operation is running, every action button is disabled.
        This fixes the original bug where only the clicked button was disabled
        and the user could fire a second operation that conflicted with the first.
        """
        busy = snap.current.value != ""
        for attr in self._OPERATION_BUTTONS_ATTRS:
            btn = getattr(self, attr, None)
            if btn is None:
                continue
            try:
                if busy:
                    btn.state(["disabled"])
                else:
                    btn.state(["!disabled"])
            except tk.TclError:
                pass


═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ФАЙЛ: ./APP/core/ui/ui_stats_panel.py
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk


class StatsPanel(ttk.LabelFrame):
    """Two progress bars: readiness (top, small) and operation (big, main).

    The two are intentionally separated so the user can see at a glance:

    * ``readiness`` — fraction of employees whose reports are ready for
      the currently selected date. Driven by
      :meth:`EmployeeListViewModel.get_progress_percent` whenever the
      employee table is re-synced.
    * ``operation`` — fraction of the long-running build/RSC/
      reconciliation task that is currently running. Driven by
      :class:`OperationState` snapshots.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent, controller):
        super().__init__(parent, text="📈 СТАТИСТИКА ДНЯ", padding=10)
        self.controller = controller
        self._setup_ui()

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.stats_label = ttk.Label(
            self,
            text="Сотрудников: 0\nОтчетов готово: 0\nОшибок: 0",
            justify=tk.LEFT,
            style="Sidebar.TLabel",
            wraplength=280,
        )
        self.stats_label.pack(fill=tk.X)

        # Readiness (small, on top). Tracks how many of today's reports
        # are present on disk — a "how much work is left" indicator.
        self._readiness_caption = ttk.Label(
            self,
            text="Готовность сотрудников:",
            style="Sidebar.TLabel",
        )
        self._readiness_caption.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10, 0))
        self.readiness_var = tk.DoubleVar()
        self.readiness_bar = ttk.Progressbar(
            self,
            variable=self.readiness_var,
            maximum=100,
        )
        self.readiness_bar.pack(fill=tk.X)

        # Operation (big, main). Tracks the running consolidation/RSC/
        # reconciliation operation, identical to what
        # OperationStatusBar shows but as a graphical bar.
        self._operation_caption = ttk.Label(
            self,
            text="Текущая операция:",
            style="Sidebar.TLabel",
        )
        self._operation_caption.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(8, 0))
        self.operation_var = tk.DoubleVar()
        self.operation_bar = ttk.Progressbar(
            self,
            variable=self.operation_var,
            maximum=100,
        )
        self.operation_bar.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(2, 0))

    def update_stats(self, ready_count, total_count, total_income=None, total_expense=None, error_count=0):
        text = f"Готово: {ready_count}/{total_count}"
        if total_income is not None and total_expense is not None:
            text += f"\nПриход: {total_income:,.2f}\nРасход: {total_expense:,.2f}"
        text += f"\nОшибки: {error_count}"
        self.stats_label.config(text=text)

    def set_readiness(self, value: float) -> None:
        """Set the small readiness bar to ``value`` (0-100)."""
        self.readiness_var.set(max(0.0, min(100.0, value)))

    def set_operation(self, value: float) -> None:
        """Set the big operation bar to ``value`` (0-100)."""
        self.operation_var.set(max(0.0, min(100.0, value)))

    def set_progress(self, value):
        """Back-compat shim. Treats the value as the operation progress
        because that was the original single-bar use; the readiness
        bar is updated explicitly via :meth:`set_readiness`.
        """
        self.set_operation(value)

    def get_progress(self):
        return self.operation_var.get()

"""Consolidation ViewModel — состояние и логика консолидации."""

import threading
from typing import Callable
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ConsolidationViewModel:
    def __init__(self, app_controller=None, operation_state=None) -> None:
        self._app_controller = app_controller
        self._operation_state = operation_state
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._is_running = False
        self._progress = 0.0
        self._on_progress: Callable[[float], None] | None = None
        self._on_complete: Callable[[bool, str, Path | None], None] | None = None

    def set_callbacks(
        self,
        on_progress: Callable[[float], None],
        on_complete: Callable[[bool, str, Path | None], None],
    ) -> None:
        self._on_progress = on_progress
        self._on_complete = on_complete

    def _execute(self, action_fn) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if self._is_running:
                return
            self._is_running = True
            self._progress = 0.0

        try:
            def on_progress(p: float) -> None:
                with self._lock:
                    self._progress = p
                if self._on_progress:
                    self._on_progress(p)

            def on_complete(ok: bool, msg: str, path: Path | None) -> None:
                with self._lock:
                    self._is_running = False
                    self._progress = 100.0 if ok else self._progress
                if self._on_complete:
                    self._on_complete(ok, msg, path)

            action_fn(on_progress, on_complete)
        except Exception:
            with self._lock:
                self._is_running = False
            if self._operation_state is not None:
                try:
                    self._operation_state.end()
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception("operation_state.end() failed in VM _execute")
            raise

    def can_run_single_date(self, missing_count: int) -> bool:
        return missing_count == 0

    def run_consolidation(
        self, app_controller=None, selected_date: datetime | None = None, curator=None,
    ) -> None:
        ctl = app_controller or self._app_controller
        cancel_event = (
            self._operation_state.cancel_event if self._operation_state else None
        )
        self._execute(
            lambda p, c: ctl.run_consolidation(
                selected_date, p, c, curator=curator, cancel_event=cancel_event,
            )
        )

    def run_consolidation_all_dates(
        self, app_controller=None, curator=None,
    ) -> None:
        ctl = app_controller or self._app_controller
        cancel_event = (
            self._operation_state.cancel_event if self._operation_state else None
        )
        self._execute(
            lambda p, c: ctl.run_consolidation_all_dates(
                p, c, curator=curator, cancel_event=cancel_event,
            )
        )

    def run_consolidation_month(
        self,
        app_controller=None,
        start_date: datetime | None = None,
        end_date: datetime | None = None,
        curator=None,
    ) -> None:
        ctl = app_controller or self._app_controller
        cancel_event = (
            self._operation_state.cancel_event if self._operation_state else None
        )
        self._execute(
            lambda p, c: ctl.run_consolidation_month(
                start_date, end_date, p, c, curator=curator, cancel_event=cancel_event,
            )
        )

    @property
    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return self._is_running

    @property
    def progress(self) -> float:
        with self._lock:
            return self._progress

    def get_button_state(self) -> str:
        return "disabled" if self._is_running else "normal"

"""Employee List ViewModel — состояние и логика списка сотрудников."""

import threading
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Callable, Optional
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class EmployeeStatus:
    """Статус одного сотрудника."""

    name: str
    status_text: str  # "🟢 ГОТОВО", "🔴 НЕТ ФАЙЛА", etc
    path_text: str  # "file.xlsx" или "[3 файлов]"
    tag: str  # "ready", "missing", "partial"

    def to_tuple(self) -> tuple:
        return (self.name, self.status_text, self.path_text, self.tag)


class EmployeeListViewModel:
    """ViewModel для списка сотрудников.

    Отделяет логику:
    - Фильтрация по поисковому запросу
    - Сортировка
    - Подсчёт статистики
    - Определение должников
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        # Separate lock for config saves. save_config() is invoked from
        # worker-thread completion callbacks (refresh_status → on_complete)
        # and writes config.yaml to disk; without serialization this races
        # with GUI-thread writes (add_employee, attach_files) and can
        # corrupt the file. Kept distinct from _lock so a slow disk write
        # does not block UI reads of viewmodel state.
        self._save_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._all_employees: List[EmployeeStatus] = []
        self._employees_map: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        self._search_query: str = ""
        self._rename_detected: bool = False
        self._last_error: Optional[str] = None
        self._on_update: Optional[Callable] = None

    def set_update_callback(self, callback: Callable) -> None:
        """Установить callback при обновлении данных."""
        self._on_update = callback

    # === Commands (действия из UI) ===

    def refresh(
        self,
        app_controller,
        selected_date: datetime,
        on_progress: Callable[[float], None],
        curator=None,
        on_error: Optional[Callable[[str], None]] = None,
        on_complete: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Запустить обновление статуса сотрудников."""

        def on_complete_inner(
            data: List[tuple], employees_map: Dict, rename_detected: bool
        ) -> None:
            with self._lock:
                self._all_employees = [
                    EmployeeStatus(name=n, status_text=s, path_text=p, tag=t)
                    for n, s, p, t in data
                ]
                self._employees_map = employees_map
                self._rename_detected = rename_detected
                self._last_error = None

            if rename_detected:
                with self._save_lock:
                    app_controller.config_controller.save_config()

            if self._on_update:
                self._on_update()
            if callable(on_complete):
                on_complete()

        def handle_error(message: str) -> None:
            with self._lock:
                self._last_error = message
            if callable(on_error):
                on_error(message)

        app_controller.refresh_status(
            selected_date,
            on_progress,
            on_complete_inner,
            curator=curator,
            on_error=handle_error,
        )

    def add_employee(self, config_controller, name: str) -> None:
        """Добавить нового сотрудника."""
        config_controller.add_employee(name)

    def delete_employee(self, config_controller, name: str) -> None:
        """Удалить сотрудника."""
        config_controller.delete_employee(name)

    def attach_files(
        self,
        config_controller,
        name: str,
        paths: List[str],
        append: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        """Прикрепить файлы к сотруднику."""
        config_controller.attach_files(name, paths, append=append)

    def get_master_path(self, config_controller) -> Optional[Path]:
        """Получить путь к мастер-файлу."""
        p = config_controller.resolve_path(
            config_controller.get_paths().get("master_file", "Master_Report.xlsx")
        )
        return p

    # === Queries (состояние для UI) ===

    @property
    def search_query(self) -> str:
        return self._search_query

    @search_query.setter
    def search_query(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._search_query = value.lower()

    def get_all_names(self) -> List[str]:
        """Return the names of every known employee.

        Used by the add-employee dialog to detect duplicate names
        before the user clicks "Добавить" and by the attach dialog to
        populate the employee combobox.
        """
        with self._lock:
            return [e.name for e in self._all_employees]

    def get_filtered_employees(self) -> List[EmployeeStatus]:
        """Получить отфильтрованный список по поисковому запросу."""
        with self._lock:
            employees = list(self._all_employees)
        if not self._search_query:
            return employees

        return [
            emp
            for emp in employees
            if any(
                self._search_query in x.lower()
                for x in (emp.name, emp.status_text, emp.path_text)
            )
        ]

    def get_ready_count(self) -> int:
        """Количество готовых сотрудников."""
        with self._lock:
            return sum(1 for e in self._all_employees if "🟢 ГОТОВО" in e.status_text)

    def get_total_count(self) -> int:
        """Общее количество."""
        with self._lock:
            return len(self._all_employees)

    def get_missing_names(self) -> List[str]:
        """Имена должников."""
        with self._lock:
            return [e.name for e in self._all_employees if "🟢 ГОТОВО" not in e.status_text]

    @property
    def rename_detected(self) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            return self._rename_detected

    @property
    def employees_map(self) -> Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Return a shallow copy of the employees map for thread safety."""
        with self._lock:
            return self._employees_map.copy()

    def get_selected_employee_path(self, selected_name: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
        """Получить путь выбранного сотрудника."""
        if not selected_name:
            return None
        with self._lock:
            metas = self._employees_map.get(selected_name, [])
        if not metas:
            return None
        meta = metas[0]
        return meta["path"] if isinstance(meta, dict) else meta

    def get_selected_employee_paths(self, selected_name: Optional[str]) -> List[str]:
        """Получить все пути выбранного сотрудника."""
        if not selected_name:
            return []
        with self._lock:
            metas = list(self._employees_map.get(selected_name, []))
        paths: List[str] = []
        for meta in metas:
            path = meta["path"] if isinstance(meta, dict) else meta
            if path:
                paths.append(path)
        return paths

    def get_progress_percent(self) -> float:
        """Процент готовности (для прогресс-бара)."""
        if not self._all_employees:
            return 0.0
        return (self.get_ready_count() / self.get_total_count()) * 100

    @property
    def last_error(self) -> Optional[str]:
        with self._lock:
            return self._last_error

-- SQLite Schema for Master Report Hybrid Cache
-- Financial fields are stored as TEXT to maintain Decimal precision in Python.

PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

-- Migration tracking (applied sequentially by filename)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _migrations (
    filename TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Session tracking
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'in_progress', -- in_progress, completed, failed
    metadata TEXT -- JSON with run parameters
);

-- File metadata and tracking
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_files (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_hash TEXT, -- MD5 fingerprint
    inode INTEGER, -- NTFS/Unix filesystem ID for rename detection
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', -- pending, indexed, processed, error
    error_message TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id)
);

-- Staging area for raw rows before consolidation
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staging_data (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    file_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    row_index INTEGER,
    raw_content_json TEXT, -- All columns from original Excel
    -- Mandatory extraction fields for filtering/sorting
    date_val TEXT,
    amount TEXT, -- Stored as TEXT to preserve Decimal precision
    employee_name TEXT,
    source_type TEXT, -- e.g. "Staff", "OPT"
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'raw', -- raw, validated, rejected
    validation_error TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES source_files(id)
);

-- Consolidated results (Final calculation cache)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consolidated_results (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    date_val TEXT,
    employee_name TEXT,
    total_amount TEXT,
    commission TEXT,
    net_amount TEXT,
    logic_applied TEXT, -- Rationale for the transformation
    FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id)
);

-- Template violations and warnings for curators
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS template_errors (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_path TEXT,
    sheet_name TEXT,
    row_index INTEGER,
    error_type TEXT,
    details TEXT,
    raw_data TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions(session_id)
);

-- File cache for found dates and metadata (optimization for network drives)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_cache (
    file_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    mtime REAL,
    size INTEGER,
    dates_json TEXT, -- JSON array of strings
    last_updated TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Cache for parsed Excel rows (avoids re-parsing unchanged files)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS row_cache (
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    mtime REAL NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_key TEXT NOT NULL, -- target_date or "all" for full file
    rows_json TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON array of row dicts
    row_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (file_path, date_key)
);

-- Cache for discovery scan results (avoids re-scanning network dirs)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS discovery_cache (
    roots_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- hash of scanned root paths
    scanned_at REAL NOT NULL, -- timestamp of scan
    files_json TEXT NOT NULL -- JSON array of file metadata
);

-- Customer aliases for reconciliation matching (managed by accountants)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_aliases (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    master_customer TEXT NOT NULL,
    rsch_customer TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(master_customer, rsch_customer)
);

-- Indexes for performance
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_session ON source_files(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_staging_file ON staging_data(file_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_staging_employee_date ON staging_data(employee_name, date_val);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_consolidated_session ON consolidated_results(session_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_row_cache_lookup ON row_cache(file_path, mtime, size);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_aliases_master ON customer_aliases(master_customer);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_aliases_rsch ON customer_aliases(rsch_customer);

import os
import sys
import signal
import logging
import threading
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

app_root = Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
if str(app_root) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(app_root))

from core.bootstrap import Bootstrap  # noqa: E402


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run headless consolidation.")
    parser.add_argument("--date", type=str, help="Date to consolidate (DD.MM.YYYY)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
    )
    logger = logging.getLogger("Headless")
    app_ctl = None
    db = None
    timeout = int(os.environ.get("HEADLESS_RUN_TIMEOUT", "600"))
    cancel_event = threading.Event()

    def _signal_handler(signum, _frame):
        # SIGTERM/SIGINT: signal the worker to cancel at its next
        # checkpoint, then exit. The worker thread is daemon=True so it
        # will be reaped when the process dies, but setting the event
        # lets it flush partial state cleanly.
        logger.warning("Received signal %s, cancelling consolidation...", signum)
        cancel_event.set()
        sys.exit(1)

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _signal_handler)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _signal_handler)

    try:
        try:
            _, app_ctl, db = Bootstrap.setup(
                app_root, str(app_root / "config.yaml")
            )
        except RuntimeError as e:
            # Bootstrap signals missing critical dependency (python-calamine)
            # by raising RuntimeError. Print to stderr for shell users / CI.
            print(f"Bootstrap failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            logger.critical(f"Bootstrap failed: {e}")
            sys.exit(1)
        done = threading.Event()

        def on_comp(ok, msg, path):
            if ok:
                logger.info(f"DONE: {msg}")
            else:
                logger.error(msg)
            done.set()

        if args.date:
            target_date = datetime.strptime(args.date, "%d.%m.%Y")
            logger.info(f"Triggering run_consolidation for {args.date}...")
            app_ctl.run_consolidation(
                target_date, lambda p: None, on_comp, cancel_event=cancel_event
            )
        else:
            logger.info("Triggering run_consolidation_all_dates...")
            app_ctl.run_consolidation_all_dates(
                lambda p: None, on_comp, cancel_event=cancel_event
            )

        finished = done.wait(timeout=timeout) if timeout > 0 else done.wait()
        if not finished:
            logger.error("Timed out waiting for consolidation to complete")
            # Signal the worker to cancel at its next checkpoint before
            # exiting; otherwise the background thread keeps running.
            cancel_event.set()
            sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.critical(f"Failed: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    finally:
        if app_ctl is not None:
            app_ctl.shutdown()
        elif db is not None:
            db.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
