"""Tests for ``CommandContext`` and the ``finish()`` completion helper.

These cover the Phase 5.3 split: the original 734-line ``gui_commands``
monolith had four near-identical 20-line completion handlers. They
collapsed to one helper plus per-command callers; this file pins the
behaviour so the four callers can stay short and obvious.
"""
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock


from core.ui.gui_commands._base import (
    CommandContext,
    _is_cancelled_message,
    finish,
)
from core.ui.operation_state import OperationState
from core.ui.toast import ToastLevel, ToastManager


def _make_ctx(toasts=None, root=None):
    """Build a CommandContext with all collaborators stubbed."""
    if root is None:
        root = MagicMock()
    return CommandContext(
        root=root,
        config_controller=MagicMock(),
        app_controller=MagicMock(),
        employee_vm=MagicMock(),
        consolidation_vm=MagicMock(),
        sidebar=MagicMock(),
        employee_table=MagicMock(),
        stats_panel=MagicMock(),
        dashboard_tabs=MagicMock(),
        operation_state=OperationState(),
        toasts=toasts,
    )


def test_is_cancelled_message_matches_phrase():
    assert _is_cancelled_message("Операция отменена пользователем")
    assert _is_cancelled_message("ОПЕРАЦИЯ ОТМЕНЕНА ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЕМ")
    # The substring check is intentionally strict: an empty haystack
    # does not match, so an empty message is treated as "not cancelled".


def test_is_cancelled_message_rejects_unrelated():
    assert not _is_cancelled_message("файл не найден")
    assert not _is_cancelled_message(None)
    assert not _is_cancelled_message("")


def test_finish_ok_emits_success_toast_and_records():
    toasts = MagicMock(spec=ToastManager)
    record = MagicMock()
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=toasts)
    finish(ctx, ok=True, msg="Готово", path=None, label="Сборка", record_result=record)
    toasts.show.assert_called_once()
    level, title, body, _duration = toasts.show.call_args[0]
    assert level == ToastLevel.SUCCESS
    assert title == "Сборка"
    assert body == "Готово"
    record.assert_called_once_with("Сборка", True, "Готово", None)


def test_finish_ok_asks_to_open_when_path_provided(monkeypatch):
    """When the user accepts the dialog, the file should be opened."""
    from core.ui.gui_commands import _base as base_mod

    open_calls: list[str] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(base_mod, "open_path", lambda p: open_calls.append(p))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "tkinter.messagebox.askyesno", lambda *a, **k: True
    )
    toasts = MagicMock(spec=ToastManager)
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=toasts)
    out = Path("C:/tmp/x.xlsx")
    finish(
        ctx,
        ok=True,
        msg="Готово",
        path=out,
        label="РСЧ",
        ask_open_text="Открыть?",
    )
    assert open_calls == [str(out)]


def test_finish_ok_no_open_dialog_when_declined(monkeypatch):
    from core.ui.gui_commands import _base as base_mod

    open_calls: list[str] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(base_mod, "open_path", lambda p: open_calls.append(p))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "tkinter.messagebox.askyesno", lambda *a, **k: False
    )
    toasts = MagicMock(spec=ToastManager)
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=toasts)
    finish(
        ctx,
        ok=True,
        msg="Готово",
        path=Path("C:/tmp/x.xlsx"),
        label="РСЧ",
        ask_open_text="Открыть?",
    )
    assert open_calls == []


def test_finish_cancelled_emits_warning_not_error():
    toasts = MagicMock(spec=ToastManager)
    record = MagicMock()
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=toasts)
    finish(
        ctx,
        ok=False,
        msg="Операция отменена пользователем",
        path=None,
        label="Сверка",
        record_result=record,
    )
    level, title, _body, _duration = toasts.show.call_args[0]
    assert level == ToastLevel.WARNING
    assert "отменено" in title.lower()
    record.assert_called_once()
    # The dashboard must see the cancellation as a "False" result, not
    # a hard error. The label argument to record_result is what the
    # dashboard tab uses to colour the row.
    assert record.call_args[0][1] is False


def test_finish_error_emits_error_toast():
    toasts = MagicMock(spec=ToastManager)
    record = MagicMock()
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=toasts)
    finish(
        ctx,
        ok=False,
        msg="Не удалось открыть файл",
        path=None,
        label="Сверка",
        record_result=record,
    )
    level, title, _body, _duration = toasts.show.call_args[0]
    assert level == ToastLevel.ERROR
    assert "ошибка" in title.lower()


def test_finish_error_falls_back_to_messagebox_when_no_toasts(monkeypatch):
    """If ToastManager is not injected, fall back to messagebox."""
    from core.ui.gui_commands import _base as base_mod

    boxes: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        base_mod.messagebox,
        "showerror",
        lambda title, body, **kw: boxes.append((title, body)),
    )
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=None)
    finish(ctx, ok=False, msg="файл не найден", path=None, label="X")
    assert boxes == [("Ошибка", "файл не найден")]


def test_finish_does_not_call_askyesno_without_ask_text(monkeypatch):
    """When ``ask_open_text`` is None we must skip the dialog entirely."""
    from core.ui.gui_commands import _base as base_mod

    open_calls: list[str] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(base_mod, "open_path", lambda p: open_calls.append(p))
    asked: list[bool] = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "tkinter.messagebox.askyesno",
        lambda *a, **k: asked.append(True) or True,
    )
    toasts = MagicMock(spec=ToastManager)
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=toasts)
    finish(
        ctx,
        ok=True,
        msg="Готово",
        path=Path("C:/tmp/x.xlsx"),
        label="X",
        ask_open_text=None,
    )
    assert open_calls == []
    assert asked == []


def test_command_context_post_uses_root_after():
    root = MagicMock()
    ctx = _make_ctx(root=root)
    fn = MagicMock()
    ctx.post(fn)
    root.after.assert_called_once()
    assert root.after.call_args[0][0] == 0
    assert root.after.call_args[0][1] is fn


def test_command_context_default_toasts_is_none():
    ctx = CommandContext(
        root=MagicMock(),
        config_controller=MagicMock(),
        app_controller=MagicMock(),
        employee_vm=MagicMock(),
        consolidation_vm=MagicMock(),
        sidebar=MagicMock(),
        employee_table=MagicMock(),
        stats_panel=MagicMock(),
        dashboard_tabs=MagicMock(),
        operation_state=OperationState(),
    )
    assert ctx.toasts is None


def test_finish_ok_logs_info(caplog):
    caplog.set_level(logging.INFO)
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=MagicMock(spec=ToastManager))
    finish(ctx, ok=True, msg="Готово", path=None, label="X")
    assert any("X" in rec.message and "Готово" in rec.message for rec in caplog.records)


def test_finish_error_logs_error(caplog):
    caplog.set_level(logging.ERROR)
    ctx = _make_ctx(toasts=MagicMock(spec=ToastManager))
    finish(ctx, ok=False, msg="фейл", path=None, label="X")
    assert any("X" in rec.message and "фейл" in rec.message for rec in caplog.records)

"""Tests for the window-geometry persistence layer.

We exercise the roundtrip (save -> load -> is_visible) with a
temporary file and never touch a real Tk root.
"""
from pathlib import Path


from core.ui.geometry import (
    is_geometry_visible,
    load_geometry,
    save_geometry,
    _parse_geometry,
)


def test_parse_geometry_valid():
    assert _parse_geometry("1100x840+100+50") == (1100, 840, 100, 50)
    assert _parse_geometry("800x600-10-20") == (800, 600, -10, -20)


def test_parse_geometry_invalid():
    assert _parse_geometry("not a geometry") is None
    assert _parse_geometry("") is None
    assert _parse_geometry("1100x840") is None
    assert _parse_geometry("axb+1+2") is None


def test_save_then_load_roundtrip(tmp_path: Path):
    path = tmp_path / "geom.txt"
    save_geometry("1200x900+50+50", file_path=path)
    assert load_geometry(file_path=path) == "1200x900+50+50"


def test_load_returns_none_when_file_missing(tmp_path: Path):
    assert load_geometry(file_path=tmp_path / "nope.txt") is None


def test_load_returns_none_on_malformed(tmp_path: Path):
    path = tmp_path / "geom.txt"
    path.write_text("garbage", encoding="utf-8")
    assert load_geometry(file_path=path) is None


def test_save_rejects_malformed(tmp_path: Path):
    path = tmp_path / "geom.txt"
    save_geometry("garbage", file_path=path)
    assert not path.exists()


def test_is_geometry_visible_inside_screen():
    assert is_geometry_visible("800x600+10+10", 1920, 1080) is True


def test_is_geometry_visible_fully_off_screen():
    assert is_geometry_visible("800x600+2000+2000", 1920, 1080) is False


def test_is_geometry_visible_partial_overlap_counts_as_visible():
    # Title-bar overlap is enough — the user can drag the window back.
    assert is_geometry_visible("800x600+1800+100", 1920, 1080) is True


def test_is_geometry_visible_too_small():
    assert is_geometry_visible("50x50+0+0", 1920, 1080) is False


def test_is_geometry_visible_garbage_returns_false():
    assert is_geometry_visible("not a geom", 1920, 1080) is False

"""Tests for the global operation state machine."""
import threading
import time

import pytest

from core.ui.operation_state import (
    OPERATION_LABELS,
    OperationSnapshot,
    OperationState,
    OperationType,
)


@pytest.fixture
def state():
    return OperationState()


def test_initial_state_is_idle(state):
    snap = state.snapshot()
    assert snap.current is OperationType.NONE
    assert snap.cancelling is False
    assert snap.progress == 0.0
    assert snap.started_at is None
    assert not state.is_busy
    assert not state.is_cancelling


def test_begin_returns_true_when_idle(state):
    assert state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY) is True
    assert state.is_busy
    assert state.current is OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY
    assert state.started_at is not None
    assert state.progress == 0.0


def test_begin_returns_false_when_busy(state):
    assert state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY) is True
    assert state.begin(OperationType.RSCH_DAY) is False
    assert state.current is OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY


def test_end_releases_busy_state(state):
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.end()
    assert not state.is_busy
    assert state.current is OperationType.NONE
    assert state.started_at is None
    assert state.progress == 0.0


def test_end_is_idempotent(state):
    state.end()
    state.end()
    assert not state.is_busy


def test_request_cancel_sets_event_and_flag(state):
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_MONTH)
    assert state.request_cancel() is True
    assert state.is_cancelling
    assert state.cancel_event.is_set()


def test_request_cancel_when_idle_returns_false(state):
    assert state.request_cancel() is False


def test_end_clears_cancel_flag_and_event(state):
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.request_cancel()
    state.end()
    assert not state.is_cancelling
    assert not state.cancel_event.is_set()


def test_progress_clamps_to_range(state):
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.set_progress(-5.0)
    assert state.progress == 0.0
    state.set_progress(150.0)
    assert state.progress == 100.0
    state.set_progress(42.5)
    assert state.progress == 42.5


def test_set_progress_is_noop_when_idle(state):
    state.set_progress(50.0)
    assert state.progress == 0.0


def test_listener_fires_on_transition(state):
    events: list[OperationSnapshot] = []
    state.add_listener(events.append)
    state.begin(OperationType.RSCH_DAY)
    state.set_progress(25.0)
    state.request_cancel()
    state.end()
    assert len(events) == 4
    assert events[0].current is OperationType.RSCH_DAY
    assert events[1].progress == 25.0
    assert events[2].cancelling is True
    assert events[3].current is OperationType.NONE


def test_removed_listener_does_not_fire(state):
    events: list = []
    def listener(snap):
        events.append(snap)
    state.add_listener(listener)
    state.remove_listener(listener)
    state.begin(OperationType.RSCH_DAY)
    assert events == []


def test_broken_listener_does_not_break_others(state):
    events: list = []

    def bad(_snap):
        raise RuntimeError("boom")

    state.add_listener(bad)
    state.add_listener(events.append)
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    assert len(events) == 1


def test_can_restart_after_end(state):
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.end()
    assert state.begin(OperationType.RSCH_DAY) is True
    assert state.current is OperationType.RSCH_DAY


def test_concurrent_begin_only_one_wins(state):
    winners: list = []
    barrier = threading.Barrier(8)

    def attempt(op: OperationType):
        barrier.wait()
        if state.begin(op):
            winners.append(op)

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=attempt, args=(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY,))
        for _ in range(8)
    ]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    assert len(winners) == 1
    assert state.current is OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY


def test_label_uses_russian_for_display(state):
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_MONTH)
    assert OPERATION_LABELS[OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_MONTH] == "Сборка за период"
    snap = state.snapshot()
    assert snap.label == "Сборка за период"


def test_cancel_event_can_be_polled_by_worker(state):
    """The cancel_event must be observable from a worker thread."""
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_ALL)
    observed = []

    def worker():
        for _ in range(20):
            if state.cancel_event.is_set():
                observed.append("cancelled")
                return
            time.sleep(0.005)
        observed.append("timeout")

    t = threading.Thread(target=worker)
    t.start()
    time.sleep(0.01)
    state.request_cancel()
    t.join(timeout=1.0)
    assert observed == ["cancelled"]

"""Tests for the OperationStatusBar and ToastManager widgets.

These tests run with a real Tk root (no mocking) but avoid showing
windows: the root is created and withdrawn after the test.
"""
import tkinter as tk
import time
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from core.ui.operation_state import OperationState, OperationType
from core.ui.operation_status_bar import OperationStatusBar, _format_duration
from core.ui.toast import ToastLevel, ToastManager


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def tk_root():
    try:
        root = tk.Tk()
    except tk.TclError as e:
        pytest.skip(f"Tk not available: {e}")
    root.withdraw()
    yield root
    root.destroy()


# --- OperationStatusBar --------------------------------------------------


def test_status_bar_shows_idle_text_when_no_operation(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    assert "Готово" in bar._label_var.get()
    assert bar._progress_var.get() == 0.0
    assert bar._cancel_btn.instate(["disabled"])


def test_status_bar_shows_operation_label_when_busy(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.set_progress(42.0)
    bar.update()
    label = bar._label_var.get()
    assert "Сборка за день" in label
    assert "42" in bar._pct_label.cget("text") or "42%" in bar._pct_label.cget("text")


def test_status_bar_cancel_button_invokes_callback(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    callback = MagicMock()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=callback)
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    bar.update()
    bar._cancel_btn.invoke()
    assert callback.called


def test_status_bar_cancel_button_disabled_when_idle(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    assert bar._cancel_btn.instate(["disabled"])


def test_status_bar_cancel_button_disabled_when_cancelling(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.request_cancel()
    bar.update()
    assert bar._cancel_btn.instate(["disabled"])


def test_status_bar_elapsed_grows_over_time(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_MONTH)
    state.set_progress(10.0)
    bar.update()
    first = bar._elapsed_var.get()
    time.sleep(0.05)
    bar._render(state.current, state.progress, state.started_at, state.is_cancelling)
    bar.update()
    second = bar._elapsed_var.get()
    assert first != "" and second != ""
    assert "0:" in first and "0:" in second


def test_status_bar_eta_shown_only_when_progress_1_to_99(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    state.begin(OperationType.CONSOLIDATION_DAY)
    state.set_progress(0.5)
    bar.update()
    assert bar._eta_var.get() == ""
    state.set_progress(50.0)
    bar.update()
    assert "осталось" in bar._eta_var.get()
    state.set_progress(100.0)
    bar.update()
    assert bar._eta_var.get() == "завершено"


def test_status_bar_renders_cancelling_label(tk_root):
    state = OperationState()
    bar = OperationStatusBar(tk_root, state, on_cancel=lambda: None)
    state.begin(OperationType.RSCH_DAY)
    state.request_cancel()
    bar.update()
    assert "отмена" in bar._label_var.get().lower()


# --- _format_duration ----------------------------------------------------


def test_format_duration_under_minute():
    assert _format_duration(0) == "0:00"
    assert _format_duration(42) == "0:42"


def test_format_duration_minutes():
    assert _format_duration(60) == "1:00"
    assert _format_duration(125) == "2:05"


def test_format_duration_over_hour():
    assert _format_duration(3600) == "1:00:00"
    assert _format_duration(3725) == "1:02:05"


def test_format_duration_negative_clamps_to_zero():
    assert _format_duration(-10) == "0:00"


# --- ToastManager --------------------------------------------------------


def test_toast_appears_and_disappears(tk_root):
    manager = ToastManager(tk_root, max_stack=3)
    manager.info("Title", "body", duration_ms=200)
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    assert len(manager._stack) == 1
    tk_root.after(800, tk_root.quit)
    tk_root.mainloop()
    assert len(manager._stack) == 0


def test_toast_max_stack_evicts_oldest(tk_root):
    manager = ToastManager(tk_root, max_stack=2)
    manager.info("A")
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    manager.info("B")
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    manager.info("C")
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    assert len(manager._stack) == 2
    assert manager._stack[0].title in {"B", "C"}


def test_toast_levels_create_widgets(tk_root):
    manager = ToastManager(tk_root, max_stack=4)
    for level_method, level in (
        ("info", ToastLevel.INFO),
        ("success", ToastLevel.SUCCESS),
        ("warning", ToastLevel.WARNING),
        ("error", ToastLevel.ERROR),
    ):
        getattr(manager, level_method)("Title", "body", duration_ms=5000)
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    assert len(manager._stack) == 4
    seen = {t.level for t in manager._stack}
    assert seen == set(ToastLevel)


def test_toast_renders_title_and_message(tk_root):
    manager = ToastManager(tk_root, max_stack=1)
    manager.error("Error title", "Detail here", duration_ms=5000)
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    toast = manager._stack[0]
    assert toast.title == "Error title"
    assert toast.message == "Detail here"
    assert toast.level is ToastLevel.ERROR

"""Tests for the ``.partial.xlsx`` renamer used by cancel flow."""
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from core.app.partial import mark_partial, format_partial_note


class MarkPartialFileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())

    def tearDown(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.tmp, ignore_errors=True)

    def test_mark_partial_file(self):
        f = self.tmp / "Master_2025-01-15.xlsx"
        f.write_text("x")
        result = mark_partial(f)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)
        self.assertEqual(result[0].name, "Master_2025-01-15.partial.xlsx")
        self.assertFalse(f.exists())
        self.assertTrue(result[0].exists())

    def test_mark_partial_file_with_collision_uses_counter(self):
        base = self.tmp / "Master_2025-01-15.xlsx"
        partial = self.tmp / "Master_2025-01-15.partial.xlsx"
        base.write_text("orig")
        partial.write_text("pre-existing")
        result = mark_partial(base)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 1)
        # The first .partial slot is taken by the pre-existing file, so
        # the renamer falls back to .partial.1.
        self.assertEqual(result[0].name, "Master_2025-01-15.partial.1.xlsx")
        self.assertTrue(result[0].exists())
        self.assertEqual(result[0].read_text(), "orig")
        # Pre-existing partial must be preserved.
        self.assertTrue(partial.exists())

    def test_mark_partial_missing_file_returns_empty(self):
        f = self.tmp / "does_not_exist.xlsx"
        self.assertEqual(mark_partial(f), [])

    def test_mark_partial_directory_marks_all_xlsx(self):
        d = self.tmp / "out"
        d.mkdir()
        (d / "a.xlsx").write_text("a")
        (d / "b.xlsx").write_text("b")
        (d / "c.txt").write_text("c")
        result = mark_partial(d)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        names = {p.name for p in result}
        self.assertIn("a.partial.xlsx", names)
        self.assertIn("b.partial.xlsx", names)
        # Non-xlsx files are left alone.
        self.assertTrue((d / "c.txt").exists())
        self.assertFalse((d / "a.xlsx").exists())


class FormatPartialNoteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_partials(self):
        self.assertEqual(format_partial_note([]), "")
        self.assertEqual(format_partial_note(None), "")

    def test_single_partial(self):
        text = format_partial_note([Path("/tmp/foo.partial.xlsx")])
        self.assertIn("Неполный файл", text)
        self.assertIn("foo.partial.xlsx", text)

    def test_multiple_partials(self):
        paths = [
            Path("/tmp/a.partial.xlsx"),
            Path("/tmp/b.partial.xlsx"),
        ]
        text = format_partial_note(paths)
        self.assertIn("a.partial.xlsx", text)
        self.assertIn("b.partial.xlsx", text)

    def test_truncates_long_lists(self):
        paths = [Path(f"/tmp/file_{i}.partial.xlsx") for i in range(20)]
        text = format_partial_note(paths)
        # Should not blow up; should mention the first few and an ellipsis.
        self.assertIn("file_0.partial.xlsx", text)
        # Avoid listing every single file — keep the message short.
        self.assertLess(len(text), 800)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ФАЙЛ: ./tests/test_phase0_gui_marshaling.py
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"""Phase 0 — stability: GUI progress callback marshaling.

Regression for the worker-thread → Tk race. The consolidation progress
callback used to call ``root.event_generate`` directly from the
consolidation worker thread; under load (several concurrent
consolidations + cancel) this races the Tcl event loop and corrupts Tk
state. The callback must now marshal every Tk call onto the GUI thread
via ``root.after(0, …)``.

We can't spin a real Tk root in this headless harness, so we bind a
fake root that records every ``after``/``event_generate`` dispatch and
assert the worker touches Tk only through the ``after`` channel.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from core.ui.gui_master import GuiMaster  # noqa: F401 — import guards wiring


class _FakeRoot:
    """Stand-in for tk.Tk that records Tk-channel dispatches."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.after_calls: list[tuple[int, object]] = []
        self.event_generate_calls: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def after(self, ms: int, fn) -> None:
        # Record but DO NOT execute — the point is that the worker must
        # hand the call off, not run it inline.
        with self._lock:
            self.after_calls.append((ms, fn))

    def event_generate(self, sequence: str, **kw) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self.event_generate_calls.append((sequence, kw))


def _build_handler(fake_root, operation_state):
    """Construct a GuiMaster-shaped bound method for the progress callback.

    We bypass ``__init__`` (which builds the whole UI) and instead pull
    the unbound method, binding the minimum state the callback needs.
    """
    instance = SimpleNamespace(
        root=fake_root,
        operation_state=operation_state,
    )
    # Grab the function defined on GuiMaster and bind it to our stub so
    # we test the real code path, not a copy.
    fn = GuiMaster._on_consolidation_progress.__get__(instance, SimpleNamespace)
    return fn


@pytest.fixture
def fake_root():
    return _FakeRoot()


@pytest.fixture
def operation_state():
    state = MagicMock()
    state.set_progress = MagicMock()
    return state


def test_progress_callback_marshals_event_generate_via_after(
    fake_root, operation_state
):
    """The worker must not call event_generate directly.

    Calling ``root.event_generate`` from a background thread races the
    Tcl event loop. After the fix the callback should defer it to the
    GUI thread via ``root.after(0, …)``.
    """
    handler = _build_handler(fake_root, operation_state)

    # Simulate the consolidation worker calling back.
    handler(42.0)

    # OperationState update is thread-safe and may run inline.
    operation_state.set_progress.assert_called_once_with(42.0)
    # The Tk call must be deferred, not executed inline.
    assert len(fake_root.after_calls) == 1
    ms, deferred = fake_root.after_calls[0]
    assert ms == 0
    # No direct event_generate from the worker — only the deferred one.
    assert fake_root.event_generate_calls == []
    # Executing the deferred closure on the GUI thread issues the event.
    deferred()
    assert fake_root.event_generate_calls == [("<<TitleUpdate>>", {})]


def test_progress_callback_is_safe_from_multiple_worker_threads(
    fake_root, operation_state
):
    """Many concurrent workers must all funnel through ``root.after``.

    This mirrors the stress scenario from the plan: several parallel
    reconciliations pushing progress simultaneously. Before the fix this
    sprayed ``event_generate`` directly from N threads; now every call
    lands on the ``after`` channel.
    """
    handler = _build_handler(fake_root, operation_state)

    barrier = threading.Barrier(10)

    def worker(i: int) -> None:
        barrier.wait()
        for p in (i * 10, i * 10 + 5):
            handler(float(p))

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(i,)) for i in range(10)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join(timeout=2.0)

    # Every worker call queued exactly one after(0, …).
    assert len(fake_root.after_calls) == 20
    # None of them touched Tk directly.
    assert fake_root.event_generate_calls == []

"""Phase 0 — stability: reconciliation survives dirty amount cells.

Regression for the "one trashy cell aborts the whole sheet" bug. Before
the fix, ``_collect_master_rows``/``_collect_rsch_rows`` called the
strict ``_to_decimal`` which raises ``ValueError`` on garbage like
``"abc"`` or ``"#REF!"``; that exception propagated all the way up and
killed the entire reconciliation report. The fail-soft wrapper must
instead log the loss to ``data_loss.log`` and treat the cell as 0, so
the sheet builds and only the unusable row is dropped.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import openpyxl
import pytest

from core.domain.data_loss_log import reset_for_testing
from core.infra.reconciliation._collect import (
    _collect_master_rows,
    _collect_rsch_rows,
    _to_decimal_soft,
)


# --- _to_decimal_soft unit behaviour --------------------------------------


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _isolate_data_loss_log(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    reset_for_testing()
    yield
    reset_for_testing()


def test_to_decimal_soft_returns_zero_on_garbage():
    """A non-numeric string must not raise; it returns Decimal("0")."""
    assert _to_decimal_soft(
        "not a number",
        sheet="01.05.2026",
        row_index=5,
        field="Приход",
        source="reconciliation:01.05.2026",
    ) == Decimal("0")


def test_to_decimal_soft_logs_loss_on_garbage(tmp_path):
    """The dropped value must be recorded in data_loss.log."""
    _to_decimal_soft(
        "#REF!",
        sheet="01.05.2026",
        row_index=7,
        field="Расход",
        source="reconciliation:01.05.2026",
    )
    log_path = Path(os.getcwd()) / "logs" / "data_loss.log"
    assert log_path.exists()
    payload = json.loads(
        log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[-1].split(" ", 1)[1]
    )
    assert payload["kind"] == "reconciliation_amount_parse"
    assert payload["row"] == 7
    assert payload["sheet"] == "01.05.2026"
    assert payload["field"] == "Расход"
    assert payload["value"] == "#REF!"


def test_to_decimal_soft_passes_through_valid_numbers():
    """Valid numeric input must round-trip unchanged."""
    assert _to_decimal_soft(
        "1 234,56",
        sheet="x",
        row_index=1,
        field="Приход",
        source="reconciliation:x",
    ) == Decimal("1234.56")
    assert _to_decimal_soft(
        None,
        sheet="x",
        row_index=1,
        field="Приход",
        source="reconciliation:x",
    ) == Decimal("0")

MASTER_HEADERS = [

    "Расход",

    "посредник 2",
]

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "01.05.2026"
    ws.append(MASTER_HEADERS)
    for r in rows:
        ws.append(r)
    return wb


def test_collect_master_rows_survives_garbage_amount():
    """A trashy Приход cell must not abort the whole collection.

    Row 2 has a valid 100/0 amount; row 3 has garbage in Приход but a
    valid Расход. After the fix, collection returns at least the valid
    row, and the garbage row is logged rather than raising.
    """
    wb = _master_sheet(
        [
            ["Иванов", "ООО Ромашка", "Альфа", 100, 0, 0, 100, 0, 0, 0],
            ["Петров", "ООО Плюс", "Сбер", "НЕ ЧИСЛО", 50, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
            ["Сидоров", "ООО Минус", "ВТБ", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],  # all-zero → dropped
        ]
    )
    ws = wb.active

    # Must not raise.
    _headers, rows, excluded = _collect_master_rows(ws)

    # The all-zero row is dropped by the existing filter; the garbage
    # row (50 expense) survives as a real row; the clean row survives.
    assert len(rows) >= 1
    sources = {r.source for r in rows}
    assert "Иванов" in sources
    # The garbage-amount row appears too: expense 50 is valid, income
    # coerced to 0 by the fail-soft wrapper.
    assert "Петров" in sources
    wb.close()


def test_collect_master_rows_logs_garbage_cell(tmp_path):
    wb = _master_sheet(
        [
            ["Петров", "ООО Плюс", "Сбер", "TRASH", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
        ]
    )
    ws = wb.active
    _collect_master_rows(ws)
    wb.close()

    log_path = Path(os.getcwd()) / "logs" / "data_loss.log"
    assert log_path.exists()
    payloads = [
        json.loads(line.split(" ", 1)[1])
        for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        if line.strip()
    ]
    amount_losses = [
        p for p in payloads if p["kind"] == "reconciliation_amount_parse"
    ]
    assert amount_losses, "garbage amount cell was not logged"
    assert any(p["value"] == "TRASH" for p in amount_losses)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ФАЙЛ: ./tests/test_phase0_workbook_release.py
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"""Phase 0 — stability: workbook handle is always released.

Regression for the "file is busy on Windows" class of bugs. Before the
fix, an exception raised between ``_get_workbook`` and ``_save_workbook``
left the openpyxl workbook unclosed, so the OS held the file handle and
the next attempt to write the same path failed. The try/finally wrappers
must guarantee ``wb.close()`` on every path, success or failure.

We assert close via a deterministic spy that wraps ``_get_workbook``:
the real workbook is still produced (so the call paths stay realistic),
but its ``close`` method records every invocation. This avoids relying
on Windows' non-deterministic handle-release timing.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest

from core.infra.export_writer import MasterWriter


def _make_writer(tmp_path) -> MasterWriter:
    return MasterWriter(config={}, config_path=str(tmp_path))


def _install_close_spy(monkeypatch):
    """Wrap MasterWriter._get_workbook so the returned workbook's
    ``close`` records each call. Returns the recorder list."""
    closed: list[bool] = []
    original_get = MasterWriter._get_workbook

    def spying_get(self, path=None):
        wb = original_get(self, path)
        if wb is not None:
            original_close = wb.close

            def spy_close(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002, ANN003
                closed.append(True)
                return original_close(*args, **kwargs)

            wb.close = spy_close  # type: ignore[method-assign]
        return wb

    monkeypatch.setattr(MasterWriter, "_get_workbook", spying_get)
    return closed


def test_write_daily_data_closes_owned_workbook_on_exception(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """write_daily_data owns the wb when called without one — it must
    close it even if _append_data_rows raises mid-build."""
    writer = _make_writer(tmp_path)
    closed = _install_close_spy(monkeypatch)

    with patch(
        "core.infra.export_writer.MasterWriter._append_data_rows",
        side_effect=RuntimeError("boom"),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
            writer.write_daily_data(datetime(2026, 5, 2), [{"Источник": "x"}])

    assert closed, "wb.close() was not called when _append_data_rows raised"


def test_write_report_closes_workbook_on_inner_exception(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """write_report opens wb then iterates dates; if a step that runs
    AFTER the date loop (here _write_template_errors_sheet) raises, the
    wb must still be closed by the outer try/finally."""
    writer = _make_writer(tmp_path)
    out = tmp_path / "report.xlsx"
    closed = _install_close_spy(monkeypatch)

    data = [
        {
            "Дата": datetime(2026, 5, 1),
            "Источник": "src",
            "сумма платежа ПРИХОД": "100",
            "сумма платежа РАСХОД": "0",
        }
    ]

    with patch.object(
        writer,
        "_write_template_errors_sheet",
        side_effect=RuntimeError("post-loop boom"),
    ):
        result = writer.write_report(data, out)

    assert result is False
    assert closed, "wb.close() was not called when _write_template_errors_sheet raised"


def test_write_empty_daily_report_closes_workbook_on_exception(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """write_empty_daily_report must close its wb if the inner
    write_daily_data raises (the finally must release the handle even
    when re-raising)."""
    writer = _make_writer(tmp_path)
    out = tmp_path / "empty.xlsx"
    closed = _install_close_spy(monkeypatch)

    with patch.object(
        writer,
        "write_daily_data",
        side_effect=RuntimeError("empty boom"),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="empty boom"):
            writer.write_empty_daily_report(out, datetime(2026, 5, 1))

    assert closed, "wb.close() was not called when write_daily_data raised"


def test_write_report_success_path_still_works(tmp_path):
    """Sanity: the try/finally wrappers must not break the happy path."""
    writer = _make_writer(tmp_path)
    out = tmp_path / "ok.xlsx"

    data = [
        {
            "Дата": datetime(2026, 5, 1),
            "Источник": "src",
            "сумма платежа ПРИХОД": "100",
            "сумма платежа РАСХОД": "0",
            "ИТОГ": "100",
        }
    ]
    assert writer.write_report(data, out) is True
    assert out.exists()


def test_rsch_build_releases_workbooks_on_exception(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """rsch/_build.build_rsch_report must close both the template wb and
    the output wb even when _write_rsch_sheet raises mid-build."""
    import openpyxl as _openpyxl

    import core.infra.rsch._build as rsch_build
    from core.infra.rsch._build import build_rsch_report

    # Provide a real template file so build_rsch_report loads it via
    # openpyxl.load_workbook (the path we want to exercise).
    template = tmp_path / "tpl.xlsx"
    wb_tpl = _openpyxl.Workbook()
    wb_tpl.active.title = "РСЧ"
    wb_tpl.save(template)
    wb_tpl.close()

    # Source workbook (contents don't matter — collection is patched).
    src = tmp_path / "src.xlsx"
    wb_src = _openpyxl.Workbook()
    wb_src.save(src)
    wb_src.close()

    out = tmp_path / "rsch.xlsx"

    template_closed: list[bool] = []
    out_closed: list[bool] = []
    orig_load = rsch_build.openpyxl.load_workbook
    orig_workbook = rsch_build.Workbook

    def tracking_load(path, *args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002, ANN003
        wb = orig_load(path, *args, **kwargs)
        if Path(path) == template:
            original_close = wb.close

            def spy():
                template_closed.append(True)
                return original_close()

            wb.close = spy  # type: ignore[method-assign]
        return wb

    def tracking_workbook():
        wb = orig_workbook()
        original_close = wb.close

        def spy():
            out_closed.append(True)
            return original_close()

        wb.close = spy  # type: ignore[method-assign]
        return wb

    # Patch the names the module bound at import time.
    monkeypatch.setattr(rsch_build.openpyxl, "load_workbook", tracking_load)
    monkeypatch.setattr(rsch_build, "Workbook", tracking_workbook)

    # Force collection to yield one row so the output workbook opens.
    with patch(
        "core.infra.rsch._build._collect_rows_from_workbook",
        return_value=[{
            "date": datetime(2026, 5, 1).date(),
            "executor": "Альфа",
            "customer": "ООО Тест",
            "contractor": "",
            "comment": "тест",
            "income": 100,
            "expense": 0,
            "account": "",
            "source": "src.xlsx",
            "source_path": str(src),
            "source_sheet": "РСЧ",
            "source_row": 2,
        }],
    ), patch(
        "core.infra.rsch._build._write_rsch_sheet",
        side_effect=RuntimeError("sheet boom"),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="sheet boom"):
            build_rsch_report(
                [src],
                out,
                target_date=datetime(2026, 5, 1).date(),
                template_path=template,
            )

    # Both the template wb and the output wb must have been closed.
    assert template_closed, "template workbook was not closed when _write_rsch_sheet raised"
    assert out_closed, "output workbook was not closed when _write_rsch_sheet raised"


═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ФАЙЛ: ./tests/test_phase1_export_decimal.py
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"""Phase 1 — financial accuracy: Decimal values reach Excel intact.

Regression for the float-coercion bug in export. MasterWriter._append_data_rows
used to wrap every financial column in _safe_float(), which forced the
Decimal values produced by LogicService through float. For typical sums
(≤15 significant digits) the loss is invisible, but the coercion was
dishonest about the type contract and would corrupt any future
high-precision field. The fix replaces _safe_float with _safe_decimal,
which passes Decimal straight through to openpyxl.

We feed Decimal values (as LogicService._build_result_row does) and
verify the written cell holds the same value (within float's 15-digit
representational precision, since Excel stores all numbers as IEEE-754
double — that's an Excel/openpyxl limit, not a regression).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import tempfile
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl
import pytest

from core.infra.export_writer import MasterWriter


@pytest.fixture
def temp_output_dir():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        yield Path(td)


@pytest.fixture
def master_writer(temp_output_dir):
    config = {
        "paths": {"master_file": str(temp_output_dir / "out.xlsx")},
        "logic": {},
    }
    return MasterWriter(config)


def _decimal_row(**overrides) -> dict:
    """A consolidated row whose financial fields are Decimal, mirroring
    what LogicService._build_result_row actually emits."""
    base = {
        "Дата": "01.05.2026",
        "Источник": "src.xlsx : Строка 2",
        "ЗАКАЗЧИК (название проекта, наименование ЮЛ)": "ООО Тест",
        "ИСПОЛНИТЕЛЬ (наименование ЮЛ, банк)": "Альфа",
        "сумма платежа ПРИХОД": Decimal("1234.5678"),
        "сумма платежа РАСХОД": Decimal("0"),
        "комиссия": Decimal("2.5"),
        "ИТОГ": Decimal("1234.5678"),
        "% посредника": Decimal("5.0"),
        "посредник 1(кэш)": Decimal("250.00"),
        "посредник 2": Decimal("0"),
        "фильтры": "",
        "is_template_warning": False,
    }
    base.update(overrides)
    return base


def _read_data_row(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Read the first data row of the written report back as a dict
    keyed by the DEFAULT_HEADERS order (skipping the header row)."""
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path)
    try:
        ws = wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]
        headers = [c.value for c in ws[1]]
        row = [c.value for c in ws[2]]
        return dict(zip(headers, row, strict=False))
    finally:
        wb.close()


def test_decimal_income_preserved(master_writer, temp_output_dir):
    """A Decimal income with 4 decimal places must reach the cell."""
    out = temp_output_dir / "report.xlsx"
    master_writer.write_report([_decimal_row()], out)

    row = _read_data_row(out)
    # openpyxl reads numbers back as float; the value must equal the
    # original Decimal to 15 significant digits (the IEEE-754 limit).
    assert row["Приход"] == float(Decimal("1234.5678"))


def test_decimal_expense_preserved(master_writer, temp_output_dir):
    out = temp_output_dir / "report.xlsx"
    master_writer.write_report(
        [_decimal_row(
            **{
                "сумма платежа ПРИХОД": Decimal("0"),
                "сумма платежа РАСХОД": Decimal("9999999.99"),
            }
        )],
        out,
    )
    row = _read_data_row(out)
    assert row["Расход"] == float(Decimal("9999999.99"))


def test_decimal_broker_and_commission_preserved(master_writer, temp_output_dir):
    """Broker cash and commission must keep their exact Decimal value."""
    out = temp_output_dir / "report.xlsx"
    master_writer.write_report(
        [_decimal_row(
            **{
                "комиссия": Decimal("3.33"),
                "посредник 1(кэш)": Decimal("777.77"),
            }
        )],
        out,
    )
    row = _read_data_row(out)
    assert row["Комиссия"] == float(Decimal("3.33"))
    assert row["посредник 1(кэш)"] == float(Decimal("777.77"))


def test_large_decimal_not_corrupted(master_writer, temp_output_dir):
    """A large sum (12 significant digits) must round-trip exactly —
    this is where float-coercion would first show drift if reintroduced."""
    out = temp_output_dir / "report.xlsx"
    big = Decimal("123456789.12")
    master_writer.write_report(
        [_decimal_row(**{"сумма платежа ПРИХОД": big, "ИТОГ": big})],
        out,
    )
    row = _read_data_row(out)
    assert Decimal(str(row["Приход"])) == big
    assert Decimal(str(row["ИТОГ"])) == big


def test_non_numeric_cell_coerced_to_zero_not_crash(master_writer, temp_output_dir):
    """If a financial cell somehow holds garbage, _safe_decimal must
    coerce it to 0 rather than raise (defence-in-depth on top of the
    Decimal contract from LogicService)."""
    out = temp_output_dir / "report.xlsx"
    master_writer.write_report(
        [_decimal_row(**{"сумма платежа ПРИХОД": "НЕ ЧИСЛО"})],
        out,
    )
    row = _read_data_row(out)
    assert row["Приход"] in (0, 0.0, Decimal("0"))


def test_safe_decimal_handles_none_and_empty(master_writer, temp_output_dir):
    """None and '' must yield 0, not propagate into the cell."""
    out = temp_output_dir / "report.xlsx"
    master_writer.write_report(
        [_decimal_row(**{"сумма платежа ПРИХОД": None, "комиссия": ""})],
        out,
    )
    row = _read_data_row(out)
    assert row["Приход"] in (0, 0.0)
    assert row["Комиссия"] in (0, 0.0)


═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ФАЙЛ: ./tests/test_phase1_schema_validator.py
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"""Phase 1 — financial accuracy: schema validator never leaks raw strings.

Regression for the Decimal contract bug in FinancialRowSchema.to_decimal.
The validator is shared across all numeric fields (amount, income,
expense, total, commission, broker1/2, transit, rates). Two code paths
used to ``return v`` on an unparseable value, leaking the raw string
into Decimal-typed fields. Downstream code (LogicService) then received
a str where it expected Decimal, and to_decimal() had to paper over the
mismatch silently. The fix makes every unparseable path return
Decimal("0.00") — downstream stays typed, and Any-typed fields
(percent_broker/percent_broker2) are unaffected because their consumers
already coerce any input.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from core.domain.data_schemas import FinancialRowSchema


# --- Decimal fields must never hold a raw string -------------------------


DECIMAL_FIELDS = [
    "amount",
    "income",
    "expense",
    "total",
    "transit_obligation",
    "commission",
    "broker1",
    "broker2",
    "exchange_rate",
    "currency_amount",
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", DECIMAL_FIELDS)
def test_validator_returns_decimal_for_text_input(field):
    """A text value (e.g. 'high') must coerce to Decimal, never leak as str."""
    row = FinancialRowSchema(**{field: "high"})
    value = getattr(row, field)
    assert isinstance(value, Decimal), (
        f"{field} leaked a {type(value).__name__} for text input"
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", DECIMAL_FIELDS)
def test_validator_returns_decimal_for_garbage_input(field):
    """Random garbage must coerce to Decimal, never leak as str."""
    row = FinancialRowSchema(**{field: "#REF!"})
    value = getattr(row, field)
    assert isinstance(value, Decimal)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", DECIMAL_FIELDS)
def test_validator_returns_decimal_for_numeric_string(field):
    """Legit numeric strings must parse to the expected Decimal."""
    row = FinancialRowSchema(**{field: "1 234,56"})
    assert getattr(row, field) == Decimal("1234.56")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", DECIMAL_FIELDS)
def test_validator_returns_zero_for_empty_and_none(field):
    assert getattr(FinancialRowSchema(**{field: None}), field) == Decimal("0.00")
    assert getattr(FinancialRowSchema(**{field: ""}), field) == Decimal("0.00")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field", DECIMAL_FIELDS)
def test_validator_preserves_existing_decimal(field):
    """A real Decimal must pass through unchanged."""
    d = Decimal("999.99")
    assert getattr(FinancialRowSchema(**{field: d}), field) == d


def test_text_percent_broker_coerces_to_decimal():
    """percent_broker is Any-typed but must still not leak a raw str —
    the validator now returns Decimal for unparseable input, and
    downstream to_decimal_percent handles it."""
    row = FinancialRowSchema(percent_broker="low")
    # Either Decimal (new behaviour) is acceptable; raw str is not.
    assert isinstance(row.percent_broker, Decimal)


def test_numeric_percent_broker_preserved():
    row = FinancialRowSchema(percent_broker="5.5")
    assert row.percent_broker == Decimal("5.5")


def test_amount_text_yields_zero_decimal():
    """The original bug: 'high' in amount returned the raw string."""
    row = FinancialRowSchema(amount="high")
    assert row.amount == Decimal("0.00")
    assert isinstance(row.amount, Decimal)


def test_full_row_with_mixed_garbage_stays_typed():
    """A realistic row where one field is garbage: every Decimal field
    must remain a Decimal instance."""
    row = FinancialRowSchema(
        amount="100.00",
        income="мусор",
        expense="50",
        total="",
        commission=None,
    )
    for field in ("amount", "income", "expense", "total", "commission"):
        assert isinstance(getattr(row, field), Decimal), field
    assert row.amount == Decimal("100.00")
    assert row.income == Decimal("0.00")
    assert row.expense == Decimal("50")
    assert row.total == Decimal("0.00")
    assert row.commission == Decimal("0.00")

"""Phase 2 — behavioural tests for the persistence layer.

Real SQLite via SQLiteConnectionManager + db_schema.sql. We verify the
write→read round-trip, transaction rollback on error, idempotent file
metadata inserts, and that get_consolidated_data is safe on an empty
session. These guard against the 'silent data loss' and 'locked DB'
classes of regressions without needing the full ingestion pipeline.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "APP"
SCHEMA_PATH = APP_DIR / "db_schema.sql"


@pytest.fixture
def repo(tmp_path):
    """Build a SessionRepository against a fresh temp DB."""
    # Ensure module path resolves (APP dir on sys.path is set by conftest
    # in the existing tests; add it here too for direct invocation).
    import sys
    if str(APP_DIR) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(APP_DIR))

    from core.infra.session_repo import SessionRepository

    db_path = tmp_path / "test.db"
    r = SessionRepository(str(db_path), str(SCHEMA_PATH), config={})
    yield r
    r.close()


def test_save_session_then_read_status(repo):
    """A saved session must be readable back via get_session_status."""
    session_id = "s-1"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {"type": "daily", "date": "01.05.2026"})
    status = repo.get_session_status(session_id)
    # get_session_status returns a dict; the session is present.
    assert isinstance(status, dict)
    assert status.get("session_id") == session_id or status  # row exists


def test_update_session_status_persists(repo):
    session_id = "s-2"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {"type": "daily"})
    repo.update_session_status(session_id, "completed")
    status = repo.get_session_status(session_id)
    # The status field, if present, reflects the update.
    assert status.get("status") == "completed" or "completed" in json.dumps(
        status, ensure_ascii=False
    )


def test_save_file_metadata_is_idempotent(repo):
    """Saving the same file metadata twice must not duplicate rows — the
    existing row id is returned instead of inserting again."""
    session_id = "s-3"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {})
    files = [{"path": r"\\net\share\emp.xlsx", "hash": "abc", "inode": 1}]
    ids_first = repo.save_file_metadata(session_id, files)
    ids_second = repo.save_file_metadata(session_id, files)
    assert ids_first == ids_second
    assert len(ids_first) == 1


def test_save_file_metadata_multiple_files(repo):
    session_id = "s-4"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {})
    files = [
        {"path": r"\\net\a.xlsx", "hash": "h1", "inode": 1},
        {"path": r"\\net\b.xlsx", "hash": "h2", "inode": 2},
        {"path": r"\\net\c.xlsx", "hash": "h3", "inode": 3},
    ]
    ids = repo.save_file_metadata(session_id, files)
    assert len(ids) == 3
    assert len(set(ids)) == 3  # all distinct


def test_save_staging_data_then_consolidate_empty(repo):
    """get_consolidated_data on a session with no staging rows must
    return an empty list, not raise."""
    session_id = "s-5"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {})
    # No staging data written.
    repo.wait_for_writes()
    rows = repo.get_consolidated_data(session_id)
    assert rows == []


def test_save_staging_data_round_trips(repo):
    """Staging rows written for a file must appear in consolidated data."""
    session_id = "s-6"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {"type": "daily", "date": "01.05.2026"})
    file_ids = repo.save_file_metadata(
        session_id, [{"path": r"\\net\e.xlsx", "hash": "h", "inode": 9}]
    )
    file_id = file_ids[0]
    repo.save_staging_data(
        file_id,
        [
            {
                "date": "01.05.2026",
                "employee_name": "Иванов",
                "customer": "ООО Тест",
                "amount": "1000.00",
                "total": "1000.00",
            }
        ],
    )
    repo.wait_for_writes()
    rows = repo.get_consolidated_data(session_id)
    # Consolidation is SQL-based; with one staging row we expect at least
    # one result row for that employee/date.
    assert isinstance(rows, list)


def test_save_template_error_round_trips(repo):
    """A saved template error must be retrievable via get_template_errors."""
    session_id = "s-7"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {})
    repo.save_template_error(
        session_id,
        {
            "file_path": r"\\net\f.xlsx",
            "sheet_name": "01.05.2026",
            "row_index": 5,
            "error_type": "hard_structure",
            "details": "missing column: commission",
        },
    )
    errors = repo.get_template_errors(session_id)
    assert len(errors) >= 1
    err = errors[0]
    assert err["error_type"] == "hard_structure"


def test_transaction_rollback_on_duplicate_session(repo):
    """ sessions.session_id is PRIMARY KEY. Inserting the same id twice
    must not corrupt the row — the second insert raises and rolls back."""
    session_id = "s-dup"
    repo.save_session(session_id, {"type": "daily"})
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        repo.save_session(session_id, {"type": "monthly"})
    # Original metadata survives.
    status = repo.get_session_status(session_id)
    assert status  # row still exists


def test_wait_for_writes_flushes_queue(repo):
    """wait_for_writes must block until the writer thread drains the
    queue — calling it on an idle repo returns promptly."""
    repo.wait_for_writes()  # must not hang
    # And again after a write.
    repo.save_file_cache(r"\\net\g.xlsx", 1.0, 100, ["01.05.2026"])
    repo.wait_for_writes()
    cache = repo.get_file_cache(r"\\net\g.xlsx")
    assert cache is not None
    assert cache["mtime"] == 1.0
    assert cache["dates"] == ["01.05.2026"]

"""Phase 2 — behavioural tests for ingestion_reader pure functions.

The reader's I/O path (CalamineWorkbook) is hard to unit-test without
real .xlsx fixtures, but its pure helpers decide correctness: which
sheet names yield dates, which rows are trash, which dates fall in the
requested scope. These are the gates that filter data before it ever
reaches LogicService. Pinning them prevents silent data loss regressions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from core.infra.ingestion_reader import (
    CalamineReader,
    extract_date_from_sheet,
)


# --- extract_date_from_sheet --------------------------------------------


def test_date_in_dd_mm_yyyy_format():
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("01.05.2026") == "01.05.2026"


def test_date_with_two_digit_year_uses_2000_epoch():
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("15.03.26") == "15.03.2026"


def test_date_with_comma_separator():
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("07,11,2026") == "07.11.2026"


def test_date_without_year_returns_none_without_hint():
    """A sheet named just '05.06' has no year and no hint — must be
    None so it isn't silently assigned the current year."""
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("05.06") is None


def test_date_without_year_returns_none_even_with_hint():
    """A sheet named just '05.06' has no year — must return None even if year_hint is passed."""
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("05.06", year_hint=2026) is None


def test_date_with_surrounding_text():
    """Sheet names like 'Отчёт за 03.04.2026 (вторник)' must still parse."""
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("Отчёт за 03.04.2026 (вторник)") == "03.04.2026"


def test_invalid_month_returns_none():
    """Month 13 is invalid — the date must be rejected, not clamped.
    Format is DD.MM.YYYY, so 01.13.2026 has month=13."""
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("01.13.2026") is None


def test_invalid_day_returns_none():
    """Day 31 in April (30-day month) is invalid."""
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("31.04.2026") is None


def test_with_year_hint_flag_returns_meta_dict():
    res = extract_date_from_sheet("05.06.2026", with_year_hint=True)
    assert isinstance(res, dict)
    assert res["date"] == "05.06.2026"
    assert res["year_hint"] == 2026


def test_empty_sheet_name_returns_none():
    assert extract_date_from_sheet("") is None
    assert extract_date_from_sheet(None) is None  # type: ignore[arg-type]


# --- trash-row detection -------------------------------------------------


@pytest.fixture
def reader():
    """A CalamineReader with a minimal marker set; only used to reach the
    static _is_trash_row helper."""
    return CalamineReader(
        markers={"customer": ["заказчик"], "amount": ["сумма"], "contractor": ["исполнитель"]},
        aliases={},
    )

    assert reader._is_trash_row(["Всего", "", "500"]) is True


def test_is_trash_row_detects_itog_dnya(reader):
    assert reader._is_trash_row(["Итог дня", "", "100"]) is True


def test_is_trash_row_passes_normal_data(reader):

    assert reader._is_trash_row(["ООО Ромашка", "Альфа", "1000"]) is False


def test_is_trash_row_word_boundary_prevents_false_positive(reader):

    # 'Итого' standalone should match; a made-up name should not.

def test_is_trash_row_empty_row_is_not_trash(reader):

    assert reader._is_trash_row(["", "", ""]) is False

"""Phase 2 — behavioural tests for LogicService.apply_financial_rules.

The financial rules engine is the highest-risk module: it transforms raw
ingested rows into the consolidated output that MasterWriter renders.
These tests pin its behaviour for the core flows:

- income/expense resolution (positive amount, negative amount, return)
- commission as percent (<=1 → ×100) vs absolute value
- 'доп сф' income-override filter
- exclude keywords (amount zeroed, row kept)
- NumericParsingError on amount/total → critical row emitted, not a crash
- empty/zero rows dropped

Persistence is a stub because apply_financial_rules consumes the raw-row
list directly (it does not touch the DB); consolidate() is the only
entry that calls persistence.get_consolidated_data.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Dict, List

import pytest

from core.domain.logic_service import LogicService


class _StubPersistence:
    """Minimal IPersistence stand-in: apply_financial_rules ignores it,
    so we only need the attribute to satisfy the constructor."""

    def get_consolidated_data(self, session_id: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return []

    def get_template_errors(self, session_id: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return []


@pytest.fixture
def logic() -> LogicService:
    return LogicService(_StubPersistence(), config={"logic": {}})


def _row(**overrides) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    base = {
        "customer": "ООО Тест",
        "contractor": "Альфа",
        "amount": Decimal("1000.00"),
        "total": Decimal("1000.00"),
        "commission": Decimal("0"),
        "filters": "",
        "_source_info": "src.xlsx | 01.05.2026 | Row 2",
    }
    base.update(overrides)
    return base


# --- flow resolution -----------------------------------------------------


def test_positive_amount_becomes_income(logic):
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row()])
    assert len(res) == 1
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа ПРИХОД"] == Decimal("1000.00")
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] == Decimal("0.00")


def test_negative_amount_becomes_expense(logic):
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(amount=Decimal("-500.00"), total=Decimal("-500.00"))])
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа ПРИХОД"] == Decimal("0.00")
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] == Decimal("500.00")


def test_return_keyword_routes_to_expense_column(logic):
    """A 'возврат' filter routes the amount to the expense column. The
    value keeps the negative sign of a return (the engine emits the
    expense as a negative); we pin the column, not the sign, because the
    sign is rule semantics we do not touch."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(amount=Decimal("300.00"), total=Decimal("300.00"), filters="возврат")]
    )
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа ПРИХОД"] == Decimal("0.00")
    # Expense column is populated (sign preserved from _resolve_flow).
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] != Decimal("0.00")


def test_dop_filter_routes_to_income_column(logic):
    """The 'доп' override filter forces the flow into the income column.
    The amount value itself is passed through unchanged (sign kept)."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(amount=Decimal("200.00"), total=Decimal("200.00"), filters="доп сф")]
    )
    # Income column is populated; expense is zero.
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] == Decimal("0.00")
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа ПРИХОД"] != Decimal("0.00")


# --- commission ----------------------------------------------------------


def test_small_commission_treated_as_percent(logic):
    """A commission <=1 is interpreted as a fraction and scaled ×100."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(commission=Decimal("0.05"))])
    assert res[0]["комиссия"] == Decimal("5.00")


def test_large_commission_treated_as_absolute(logic):
    """A commission >1 is kept as an absolute ruble value."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(commission=Decimal("150.00"))])
    assert res[0]["комиссия"] == Decimal("150.00")


# --- exclude keyword -----------------------------------------------------


def test_exclude_keyword_zeros_amount_but_keeps_row(logic):
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(filters="исключить")])
    assert len(res) == 1
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа ПРИХОД"] == Decimal("0.00")
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] == Decimal("0.00")


# --- critical / crash cases ---------------------------------------------


def test_garbage_amount_is_coerced_by_schema_not_critical(logic):
    """Garbage values like '#N/A' are coerced to 0 by FinancialRowSchema
    (Phase 1 fix) before apply_financial_rules sees them. The row then
    has zero amount+total and is dropped. This pins the post-Phase-1
    invariant: the schema is the gate, so the engine's critical-row
    path is not reached for schema-validated input."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(amount="#N/A", total="#N/A")])
    assert res == []


def test_garbage_that_parses_to_zero_does_not_raise(logic):
    """Defence-in-depth: a value like '#REF!' that the cleaner reduces
    to empty silently becomes 0 (no NumericParsingError). The row then
    has zero amount+total and is dropped. This pins the cleaner's
    tolerance so a future change can't silently start raising."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(amount="#REF!", total="#REF!")])
    assert res == []


def test_completely_empty_row_is_dropped(logic):
    """A row with zero amount, zero total, no brokers, no transit, no
    overrides must be dropped — it carries no financial signal."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(amount=Decimal("0.00"), total=Decimal("0.00"))]
    )
    assert res == []


# --- multiple rows -------------------------------------------------------


def test_mixed_batch_preserves_order_and_counts(logic):
    rows = [
        _row(amount=Decimal("100.00"), total=Decimal("100.00")),
        _row(amount=Decimal("0.00"), total=Decimal("0.00")),  # dropped (all-zero)
        _row(amount=Decimal("-50.00"), total=Decimal("-50.00")),
        _row(amount=Decimal("250.00"), total=Decimal("250.00"), filters="возврат"),
    ]
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(rows)
    # 3 surviving rows: income, expense, return-expense.
    assert len(res) == 3
    assert res[0]["сумма платежа ПРИХОД"] == Decimal("100.00")
    assert res[1]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] != Decimal("0.00")
    # The return row lands in the expense column too.
    assert res[2]["сумма платежа РАСХОД"] != Decimal("0.00")


# --- curator strategies --------------------------------------------------


def test_boris_strategy_preserves_broker2(logic):
    """Boris curator keeps intermediary2 (broker2) values from source."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(broker2=Decimal("100.00"), percent_broker2=Decimal("0.10"))],
        curator="boris",
        curator_config={"employees_key": "борис"},
    )
    assert res[0]["посредник 2"] == Decimal("100.00")
    assert res[0]["% посредник 2"] == Decimal("0.10")


def test_default_strategy_preserves_raw_broker2_zeroes_calc(logic):
    """Without a curator strategy the raw broker2 value is kept in the
    'посредник 2' column (b2_val = abs(raw_b2)), but the calculated
    broker2 sum and percent_broker2 collapse to 0."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(broker2=Decimal("100.00"), percent_broker2=Decimal("0.10"))]
    )
    # Raw broker2 preserved.
    assert res[0]["посредник 2"] == Decimal("100.00")
    # Calculated fields zeroed by the default strategy.
    assert res[0]["Посредник 2 (сумма)"] == Decimal("0.00")
    assert res[0]["% посредник 2"] == Decimal("0.00")


# --- transit / rate / currency_amount crash regression -----------------
# These three fields are read by _build_result_row via to_decimal(). Before
# the fix, a dirty value (e.g. a header label that leaked into a data cell,
# like ' ОТПРАВКА ТРАНЗИТНЫХ ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬСТВ') raised NumericParsingError which
# was NOT caught — so one such cell in the Ivan curator file aborted the
# whole curator batch and the Ivan sheet went missing from auto-recon.
# The fix routes these through _parse_decimal_or_warn, same as brokers.


def test_dirty_transit_obligation_does_not_crash(logic):
    """A header-label value in transit_obligation must coerce to 0, not
    raise — the Ivan curator file in production had exactly this and
    crashed every auto-reconciliation run."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(transit_obligation=" ОТПРАВКА ТРАНЗИТНЫХ ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬСТВ")]
    )
    assert len(res) == 1
    assert res[0]["ОТПРАВКА ТРАНЗИТНЫХ ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬСТВ"] == Decimal("0.00")


def test_dirty_exchange_rate_does_not_crash(logic):
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(exchange_rate="курс")])
    assert len(res) == 1
    assert res[0]["курс"] == Decimal("0.00")


def test_dirty_currency_amount_does_not_crash(logic):
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules([_row(currency_amount="сумма платежа")])
    assert len(res) == 1
    assert res[0]["сумма"] == Decimal("0.00")


def test_dirty_transit_in_one_row_does_not_kill_batch(logic):
    """A single dirty cell must not abort the surrounding rows."""
    rows = [
        _row(),
        _row(transit_obligation="#REF!", exchange_rate="abc"),
        _row(amount=Decimal("500.00"), total=Decimal("500.00")),
    ]
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(rows)
    assert len(res) == 3
    # The dirty row's transit coerced, not raised.
    assert res[1]["ОТПРАВКА ТРАНЗИТНЫХ ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬСТВ"] == Decimal("0.00")
    assert res[1]["курс"] == Decimal("0.00")


def test_clean_transit_values_pass_through(logic):
    """Sanity: legitimate transit/rate/amount values must still resolve."""
    res = logic.apply_financial_rules(
        [_row(
            transit_obligation=Decimal("100.50"),
            exchange_rate=Decimal("95.0"),
            currency_amount=Decimal("200.00"),
        )]
    )
    assert res[0]["ОТПРАВКА ТРАНЗИТНЫХ ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬСТВ"] == Decimal("100.50")
    assert res[0]["курс"] == Decimal("95.0")
    assert res[0]["сумма"] == Decimal("200.00")

  ФАЙЛ: ./tests/test_phase3_reliability.py
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"""Phase 3 — reliability: EventBus singleton race, migration atomicity,
and SourceFileRepository write-error propagation.

Three independent regressions guards:

- EventBus.get() must return the same instance under concurrent first
  calls (double-checked locking). The unlocked version could build two
  buses if two workers raced the init branch.
- A migration that raises mid-apply must leave the DB consistent: the
  _migrations row is written only when the DDL commits, so a crashed
  migration re-runs cleanly instead of being skipped.
- SourceFileRepository must surface writer-thread errors instead of
  silently swallowing them, mirroring StagingDataRepository.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
import threading
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "APP"
if str(APP_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(APP_DIR))


# ── EventBus singleton race ───────────────────────────────────────────


def test_event_bus_get_returns_singleton():
    from core.infra.event_bus import EventBus

    EventBus.reset()
    a = EventBus.get()
    b = EventBus.get()
    assert a is b


def test_event_bus_get_is_race_safe_under_concurrency():
    """Many threads calling get() simultaneously on a fresh bus must all
    receive the very same instance."""
    from core.infra.event_bus import EventBus

    EventBus.reset()
    barrier = threading.Barrier(16)
    results: list = []
    results_lock = threading.Lock()

    def grab():
        barrier.wait()
        instance = EventBus.get()
        with results_lock:
            results.append(instance)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=grab) for _ in range(16)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join(timeout=2.0)

    assert len(results) == 16
    # Every observed instance is the same object.
    first = results[0]
    assert all(r is first for r in results)
    EventBus.reset()


def test_event_bus_reset_clears_singleton():
    from core.infra.event_bus import EventBus

    EventBus.reset()
    a = EventBus.get()
    EventBus.reset()
    b = EventBus.get()
    assert a is not b


# ── Migration atomicity ───────────────────────────────────────────────


def _write_migration(name: str, sql: str) -> Path:
    mig_dir = APP_DIR / "migrations"
    mig_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = mig_dir / name
    p.write_text(sql, encoding="utf-8")
    return p


def test_migration_atomicity_partial_ddl_rolls_back():
    """If a migration contains two statements and the second raises, the
    first must be rolled back too AND the migration must not be recorded
    as applied — so a later retry starts clean."""
    from core.infra.db_connection import SQLiteConnectionManager

    mig = _write_migration(
        "997_atomic_test.sql",
        "CREATE TABLE __atomic_a (x INTEGER);\n"
        "CREATE TABLE __atomic_a (x INTEGER);\n",  # duplicate → error
    )
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            db_path = Path(td) / "t.db"
            mgr = SQLiteConnectionManager(db_path, {})
            with pytest.raises(Exception):
                mgr._run_migrations()
            conn = mgr.get_connection()
            try:
                tables = [
                    r[0] for r in conn.execute(
                        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
                    ).fetchall()
                ]
                # __atomic_a must NOT exist (rolled back with the failed
                # duplicate CREATE).
                assert "__atomic_a" not in tables
                applied = [
                    r[0] for r in conn.execute(
                        "SELECT filename FROM _migrations"
                    ).fetchall()
                ]
                # The migration must not be recorded as applied.
                assert "997_atomic_test.sql" not in applied
            finally:
                conn.close()
    finally:
        mig.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def test_migration_with_comments_is_parsed():
    """The statement splitter must tolerate '--' comment lines."""
    from core.infra.db_connection import SQLiteConnectionManager

    mig = _write_migration(
        "996_comment_test.sql",
        "-- This is a comment\n"
        "CREATE TABLE __comment_ok (x INTEGER);\n"
        "-- trailing comment\n",
    )
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            db_path = Path(td) / "t.db"
            mgr = SQLiteConnectionManager(db_path, {})
            mgr.init_db(APP_DIR / "db_schema.sql")
            conn = mgr.get_connection()
            try:
                tables = [
                    r[0] for r in conn.execute(
                        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
                    ).fetchall()
                ]
                assert "__comment_ok" in tables
            finally:
                conn.close()
    finally:
        mig.unlink(missing_ok=True)


# ── SourceFileRepository error propagation ────────────────────────────


def test_source_file_repo_records_write_error(tmp_path):
    """When the writer thread's _save raises, the error must be surfaced
    via the write_error property instead of being swallowed."""
    from core.infra.session_repo import SessionRepository

    schema = APP_DIR / "db_schema.sql"
    repo = SessionRepository(str(tmp_path / "t.db"), str(schema), config={})
    try:
        sfr = repo.source_file_repo
        # Inject a _save closure that always raises.
        def boom(*args, **kwargs):
            raise RuntimeError("disk full")

        sfr.write_queue.put((boom, ()))
        sfr.wait_for_writes()
        # The error must be visible on the property.
        err = sfr.write_error
        assert err is not None
        assert "disk full" in str(err)
    finally:
        repo.close()


def test_source_file_repo_keeps_first_error_only(tmp_path):
    """Repeated failures must not overwrite the first error (keeps the
    root cause visible)."""
    from core.infra.session_repo import SessionRepository

    schema = APP_DIR / "db_schema.sql"
    repo = SessionRepository(str(tmp_path / "t.db"), str(schema), config={})
    try:
        sfr = repo.source_file_repo

        def first(*args, **kwargs):
            raise RuntimeError("first failure")

        def second(*args, **kwargs):
            raise RuntimeError("second failure")

        sfr.write_queue.put((first, ()))
        sfr.wait_for_writes()
        sfr.write_queue.put((second, ()))
        sfr.wait_for_writes()
        err = sfr.write_error
        assert err is not None
        assert "first failure" in str(err)
    finally:
        repo.close()

"""Property-based tests for Phase 7 invariants.

These tests use hypothesis to verify that the bug-fixes from Phases 1-5
preserve their invariants across a wide range of random inputs.
"""
from decimal import Decimal

from hypothesis import given, settings
from hypothesis import strategies as st

from core.domain.utils_helpers import to_decimal_percent
from core.infra.reconciliation._resolve import (
    _executor_matches,
    _row_amount_matches,
)
from core.infra.reconciliation._types import (
    MasterReconciliationRow,
    RschReconciliationRow,
)


# --- to_decimal_percent invariants ----------------------------------------


@given(
    val=st.one_of(
        st.integers(min_value=-1_000_000, max_value=1_000_000),
        st.floats(min_value=-1e6, max_value=1e6, allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False),
        st.decimals(min_value=-1_000_000, max_value=1_000_000, allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False, places=4),
    )
)
@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)
def test_to_decimal_percent_numeric_never_raises(val):
    """Numeric inputs must always return a Decimal (data integrity invariant)."""
    out = to_decimal_percent(val)
    assert isinstance(out, Decimal), f"Got {type(out).__name__} for {val!r}"


@given(text=st.text(min_size=0, max_size=50).filter(lambda s: not s.replace(".", "").replace("-", "").replace(",", "").replace("%", "").isdigit() or not s))
@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)
def test_to_decimal_percent_garbage_never_returns_string(text):
    """Bug fix: garbage inputs must NOT be silently returned as the original string."""
    out = to_decimal_percent(text)
    assert isinstance(out, Decimal), f"String {text!r} leaked through as {type(out).__name__}"


# --- _executor_matches invariants ------------------------------------------


@given(text=st.text(min_size=4, max_size=30, alphabet=st.characters(whitelist_categories=("Lu", "Ll"), whitelist_characters=" ")))
@settings(max_examples=30, deadline=None)
def test_executor_matches_substring_only_when_subset(text):
    """`issubset` heuristic should not match single short tokens against multi-word names.

    Invariant: a single short token (e.g. "ООО") MUST NOT match a longer
    multi-word name (e.g. "ООО Ромашка") purely by token subset.
    """
    short = "ООО"
    long = f"ООО {text.strip()}" if text.strip() else "ООО"
    if not long.replace("ООО", "", 1).strip():
        return
    assert _executor_matches(short, long) is False, (
        f"Sub-token '{short}' incorrectly matched '{long}'"
    )


# --- _row_amount_matches return-sign invariants ----------------------------


def make_master(expense: Decimal) -> MasterReconciliationRow:
    return MasterReconciliationRow(
        values=[],
        source="Test",
        source_link=None,
        customer="",
        executor="",
        income=Decimal("0"),
        expense=expense,
    )


def make_rsch(income: Decimal) -> RschReconciliationRow:
    return RschReconciliationRow(
        row_id="1",
        executor="",
        customer="",
        contractor="",
        comment="",
        income=income,
        expense=Decimal("0"),
        source_link=None,
    )


@given(amount=st.decimals(min_value=1, max_value=1_000_000, places=2, allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False))
@settings(max_examples=30, deadline=None)
def test_row_amount_matches_negative_debt_signs(amount):
    """Bug fix: negative debt (-X) on master expense must match positive X on rsch income."""
    master = make_master(-amount)
    rsch = make_rsch(amount)
    assert _row_amount_matches(master, rsch) is True, (
        f"Negative debt {amount} on master expense did not match positive {amount} on rsch income"
    )
