"""Tests for the system theme detector.

The detector never imports GUI code, so we can drive every platform
branch through ``patch``.
"""
import platform


from core.ui.system_theme import (
    detect_system_theme,
    is_windows_8_or_earlier,
)


def test_detect_windows_light_when_registry_value_1(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Windows")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.ui.system_theme._windows_apps_use_light", lambda: True)
    assert detect_system_theme() == "light"


def test_detect_windows_dark_when_registry_value_0(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Windows")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.ui.system_theme._windows_apps_use_light", lambda: False)
    assert detect_system_theme() == "dark"


def test_detect_windows_8_falls_back_to_none(monkeypatch):
    """On Windows 8 the registry key is absent, so detection fails.

    The caller (ThemeManager) treats ``None`` as 'ask the user'.
    """
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Windows")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.ui.system_theme._windows_apps_use_light", lambda: None)
    assert detect_system_theme() is None


def test_detect_macos_light(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Darwin")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.ui.system_theme._macos_appearance", lambda: True)
    assert detect_system_theme() == "light"


def test_detect_macos_dark(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Darwin")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.ui.system_theme._macos_appearance", lambda: False)
    assert detect_system_theme() == "dark"


def test_detect_linux_dark(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Linux")
    monkeypatch.setattr("core.ui.system_theme._linux_gnome_dark", lambda: False)
    assert detect_system_theme() == "dark"


def test_detect_unknown_os_returns_none(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Plan9")
    assert detect_system_theme() is None


def test_is_windows_8_or_earlier_on_windows_8(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Windows")
    # Win 8 surfaces through ``platform.release`` as the user-visible
    # version "8" (the kernel 6.2 is hidden from Python 3.13+).
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "release", lambda: "8", raising=False)
    assert is_windows_8_or_earlier() is True


def test_is_windows_8_or_earlier_on_windows_7(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Windows")
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "release", lambda: "7", raising=False)
    assert is_windows_8_or_earlier() is True


def test_is_windows_8_or_earlier_on_windows_10(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Windows")
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "release", lambda: "10", raising=False)
    assert is_windows_8_or_earlier() is False


def test_is_windows_8_or_earlier_on_linux(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(platform, "system", lambda: "Linux")
    assert is_windows_8_or_earlier() is False


def test_windows_apps_use_light_handles_missing_winreg(monkeypatch):
    """The detector must not raise on a non-Windows runtime."""
    from core.ui.system_theme import _windows_apps_use_light

    import builtins

    real_import = builtins.__import__

    def fake_import(name, *args, **kwargs):
        if name == "winreg":
            raise ImportError("no winreg")
        return real_import(name, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "__import__", fake_import)
    assert _windows_apps_use_light() is None

"""Tests for the dark/light theme manager and the system-theme resolver.

The theme manager is intentionally pure (no Tk) so we can drive most
of it from a normal test. The only Tk-bound surface is ``apply_styles``,
which we exercise through a withdrawn Tk root.
"""
import tkinter as tk
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest

from core.ui.theme import ThemeManager


@pytest.fixture
def fresh_theme():
    """Reset the theme between tests so we never see leakage."""
    yield
    ThemeManager.set_theme("light")


def test_default_theme_is_light(fresh_theme):
    assert ThemeManager.current_theme() == "light"
    assert ThemeManager.COLORS["bg_main"] == "#f3f4f6"


def test_set_theme_dark_changes_palette(fresh_theme):
    ThemeManager.set_theme("dark")
    assert ThemeManager.current_theme() == "dark"
    assert ThemeManager.COLORS["bg_main"] == "#0f172a"


def test_set_theme_unknown_raises(fresh_theme):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ThemeManager.set_theme("neon-pink")


def test_palette_returns_fresh_copy(fresh_theme):
    a = ThemeManager.palette()
    a["bg_main"] = "#000000"
    b = ThemeManager.palette()
    assert b["bg_main"] != "#000000"


def test_resolve_effective_passthrough(fresh_theme):
    assert ThemeManager.resolve_effective("light") == "light"
    assert ThemeManager.resolve_effective("dark") == "dark"


def test_resolve_effective_system_calls_detector(fresh_theme):
    with patch("core.ui.system_theme.detect_system_theme", return_value="dark") as d:
        assert ThemeManager.resolve_effective("system") == "dark"
        d.assert_called_once()


def test_resolve_effective_system_fallback_when_detector_returns_none(fresh_theme):
    with patch("core.ui.system_theme.detect_system_theme", return_value=None):
        assert ThemeManager.resolve_effective("system") == "light"


def test_apply_styles_writes_ttk_options(fresh_theme):
    try:
        root = tk.Tk()
    except tk.TclError as e:
        pytest.skip(f"Tk not available: {e}")
    root.withdraw()
    try:
        ThemeManager.set_theme("dark")
        from tkinter import ttk
        style = ttk.Style()
        assert style.lookup("TLabel", "background") == ThemeManager.COLORS["bg_main"]
        ThemeManager.set_theme("light")
        assert style.lookup("TLabel", "background") == "#f3f4f6"
    finally:
        root.destroy()

"""Tests for the Tooltip widget.

These tests use a withdrawn Tk root to avoid showing windows during
the test run. We exercise the show/hide lifecycle and the text
update API.
"""
import tkinter as tk
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from core.ui.tooltip import Tooltip


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def tk_root():
    try:
        root = tk.Tk()
    except tk.TclError as e:
        pytest.skip(f"Tk not available: {e}")
    root.withdraw()
    yield root
    root.destroy()


def test_tooltip_starts_hidden(tk_root):
    btn = tk.Button(tk_root, text="Run")
    tip = Tooltip(btn, "Run the consolidation", delay_ms=10)
    assert tip._tip is None


def _wait_until(condition, timeout_ms=1000, root=None):
    """Pump the Tk event loop until ``condition`` is truthy or we time out."""
    import time
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_ms / 1000.0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if condition():
            return True
        if root is not None:
            root.update()
        time.sleep(0.01)
    return False


def _fake_enter(tip, widget):
    """Drive the Tooltip's enter handler directly.

    Tk's ``event_generate`` does not invoke bindings on a non-mapped
    widget under the test runner, so we call the bound Python method
    directly with a minimal mock event that has the attributes the
    handler reads (``x_root`` and ``y_root``).
    """
    event = MagicMock(spec=["x_root", "y_root"])
    event.x_root = 100
    event.y_root = 200
    tip._on_enter(event)
    # event_generate on a mapped widget would also work; this is the
    # safe path for headless tests.
    _ = widget  # keep the signature consistent with the previous version


def test_tooltip_shows_on_hover(tk_root):
    btn = tk.Button(tk_root, text="Run")
    tip = Tooltip(btn, "Run it", delay_ms=10)
    _fake_enter(tip, btn)
    assert _wait_until(lambda: tip._tip is not None, root=tk_root)
    assert tip._tip.winfo_exists()
    tip._on_leave(None)
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    assert tip._tip is None


def test_tooltip_cancel_pending_hides(tk_root):
    btn = tk.Button(tk_root, text="Run")
    tip = Tooltip(btn, "x", delay_ms=1000)
    _fake_enter(tip, btn)
    tip._on_leave(None)
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    assert tip._tip is None


def test_tooltip_set_text_updates_visible(tk_root):
    btn = tk.Button(tk_root, text="Run")
    tip = Tooltip(btn, "old", delay_ms=10)
    _fake_enter(tip, btn)
    assert _wait_until(lambda: tip._tip is not None, root=tk_root)
    tip.set_text("new")
    tk_root.update_idletasks()
    label = getattr(tip._tip, "_label", None)
    assert label is not None
    assert label.cget("text") == "new"
    tip._on_leave(None)

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Cleans transient files left by launcher bat scripts and stale pycache.

.DESCRIPTION
  Removes known junk files from the project root and stale __pycache__
  directories under APP/. Safe to run at any time — only deletes
  regenerable/transient artifacts.

.USAGE
  .\tools\cleanup.ps1              # clean root junk
  .\tools\cleanup.ps1 -Full        # also prune __pycache__ and .pyc
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Full
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

$junkFiles = @(
    'console_err.txt',
    'console_out.txt',
    'err.txt',
    'out.txt',
    'last_bat_err.txt',
    'last_bat_out.txt',
    'update_log.txt'
)

$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

foreach ($f in $junkFiles) {
    $p = Join-Path $root $f
    if (Test-Path $p) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force
        Write-Host "Removed: $f"
    }
}

if ($Full) {
    Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $root 'APP') -Recurse -Directory -Filter '__pycache__' |
        ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force; Write-Host "Removed: $($_.FullName)" }
    Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Filter '*.pyc' -Recurse |
        ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Force }
    Write-Host "Pruned __pycache__ and .pyc files."
}

Write-Host "Cleanup complete."

import sys
import os
import difflib

ws1 = r"e:\Dlia Dashi\Version5\APP"
ws2 = r"C:\Users\vanya\Desktop\workspace-25b6a0ab-0a35-4c0a-aa7c-abe7168cc6fa\upload\extracted\APP"

files = [
    r"core/infra/staging_repo.py",
    r"core/infra/ingestion_reader.py",
    r"core/domain/logic_service.py",
    r"core/domain/data_loss_log.py"
]

for rel_path in files:
    p1 = os.path.join(ws1, rel_path.replace("/", "\\"))
    p2 = os.path.join(ws2, rel_path.replace("/", "\\"))
    
    if not os.path.exists(p1):
        print(f"File missing in ws1: {p1}")
        continue
    if not os.path.exists(p2):
        print(f"File missing in ws2: {p2}")
        continue
        
    with open(p1, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f1, open(p2, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f2:
        lines1 = f1.readlines()
        lines2 = f2.readlines()
        
    diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(
        lines1, lines2,
        fromfile=f"ws1/{rel_path}",
        tofile=f"ws2/{rel_path}",
        n=2
    ))
    
    if diff:
        print(f"=== DIFF FOR {rel_path} ===")
        sys.stdout.writelines(diff)
        print("\n" + "="*50 + "\n")
    else:
        print(f"No diff for {rel_path}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Merge all project source files into a single PDF document.

Includes:
- All .py files under APP/
- Root config files (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml)
- Batch launchers (.bat)
- tools/ scripts (.py, .ps1)

Usage:
    python tools/merge_to_pdf.py          # -> project_source_code.pdf
    python tools/merge_to_pdf.py -o out.pdf
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from fpdf import FPDF

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

# --- File groups and ordering ---

APP_PY: list[Path] = sorted(
    p for p in Path(REPO_ROOT, "APP").rglob("*.py")
)

ROOT_CONFIGS: list[Path] = [
    Path(REPO_ROOT, "requirements.txt"),
    Path(REPO_ROOT, "requirements-dev.txt"),
    Path(REPO_ROOT, "pyproject.toml"),
]

ROOT_BATS: list[Path] = sorted(Path(REPO_ROOT).glob("*.bat"))

TOOLS_SCRIPTS: list[Path] = sorted(
    p for p in Path(REPO_ROOT, "tools").glob("*")
    if p.suffix in (".py", ".ps1")
)

# Combine into final order
ALL_FILES: list[Path] = APP_PY + ROOT_CONFIGS + ROOT_BATS + TOOLS_SCRIPTS
ALL_FILES = [p for p in ALL_FILES if p.is_file()]


class CodePDF(FPDF):
    """PDF builder with syntax-friendly monospace layout."""

    FONT_SIZE = 7
    LINE_HEIGHT = 3.2
    LEFT_MARGIN = 10
    RIGHT_MARGIN = 10

    def header(self) -> None:
        self.set_font(self._font_family, "B", 7)
        self.set_text_color(120, 120, 120)
        rel = self._current_rel_path()
        self.cell(0, 4, f"Master-Report — {rel}", align="R", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        self.set_draw_color(200, 200, 200)
        self.line(self.l_margin, self.get_y(), self.w - self.r_margin, self.get_y())
        self.ln(2)

    def footer(self) -> None:
        self.set_y(-12)
        self.set_font(self._font_family, "", 6)
        self.set_text_color(150, 150, 150)
        self.cell(0, 8, f"{self.page_no()}/{{nb}}", align="C")

    def _current_rel_path(self) -> str:
        return getattr(self, "_rel_path", "")

    def add_file(self, path: Path) -> None:
        rel = path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)
        self._rel_path = str(rel)

        # --- Title page / separator ---
        self.add_page()
        self.ln(15)
        self.set_font(self._font_family, "B", 14)
        self.set_text_color(30, 30, 30)
        self.cell(0, 8, str(rel), new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT", align="C")

        self.set_font(self._font_family, "", 8)
        self.set_text_color(100, 100, 100)
        lines = len(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines())
        self.cell(0, 5, f"{lines} lines  •  {path.stat().st_size:,} bytes", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT", align="C")

        self.set_draw_color(180, 180, 180)
        self.line(self.l_margin + 30, self.get_y() + 2, self.w - self.r_margin - 30, self.get_y() + 2)

        # --- Code content ---
        self.add_page()
        self.set_font(self._font_family, "", self.FONT_SIZE)
        self.set_text_color(20, 20, 20)

        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        for raw_line in text.splitlines():
            display = raw_line.replace("\t", "    ")
            if display.strip() == "":
                self.ln(self.LINE_HEIGHT)
            else:
                self.cell(0, self.LINE_HEIGHT, display, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")

    def _setup_fonts(self) -> None:
        """Register a Unicode-safe monospace font.

        Prefers Consola (Windows system font), falls back to Courier.
        """
        import os

        windir = os.environ.get("WINDIR", r"C:\Windows")
        fonts_dir = os.path.join(windir, "Fonts")
        regular = os.path.join(fonts_dir, "consola.ttf")
        bold = os.path.join(fonts_dir, "consolab.ttf")

        if os.path.isfile(regular):
            self.add_font("Code", "", regular)
            if os.path.isfile(bold):
                self.add_font("Code", "B", bold)
            self._font_family = "Code"
        else:
            self._font_family = "Courier"

    def finish(self, output: Path) -> None:
        self.alias_nb_pages()
        self.output(str(output))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Merge project source into one PDF")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", type=Path, default=Path(REPO_ROOT, "project_source_code.pdf"))
    args = parser.parse_args()

    pdf = CodePDF()
    pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
    pdf.set_left_margin(pdf.LEFT_MARGIN)
    pdf.set_right_margin(pdf.RIGHT_MARGIN)
    pdf._setup_fonts()

    print(f"Merging {len(ALL_FILES)} files into {args.output.name} ...")
    for i, f in enumerate(ALL_FILES, 1):
        rel = f.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)
        print(f"  [{i:3d}/{len(ALL_FILES)}] {rel}")
        try:
            pdf.add_file(f)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"  WARNING: {rel}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)

    pdf.finish(args.output)
    size_mb = args.output.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
    print(f"\nDone: {args.output} ({size_mb:.1f} MB, {pdf.page_no()} pages)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Merge all project source files into a single text file.

Includes:
- All .py files under APP/
- Root config files (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml)
- Batch launchers (.bat)
- tools/ scripts (.py, .ps1)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

# --- File groups and ordering ---
APP_PY = sorted(p for p in Path(REPO_ROOT, "APP").rglob("*.py"))
ROOT_CONFIGS = [
    Path(REPO_ROOT, "requirements.txt"),
    Path(REPO_ROOT, "requirements-dev.txt"),
    Path(REPO_ROOT, "pyproject.toml"),
]
ROOT_BATS = sorted(Path(REPO_ROOT).glob("*.bat"))
TOOLS_SCRIPTS = sorted(
    p for p in Path(REPO_ROOT, "tools").glob("*")
    if p.suffix in (".py", ".ps1")
)

# Combine into final order
ALL_FILES = APP_PY + ROOT_CONFIGS + ROOT_BATS + TOOLS_SCRIPTS
ALL_FILES = [p for p in ALL_FILES if p.is_file()]

# Exclude itself and target output files to avoid self-inclusion or duplicate runs
EXCLUDED_NAMES = {"merge_to_txt.py", "project_source_code.txt", "project_code.txt"}
ALL_FILES = [p for p in ALL_FILES if p.name not in EXCLUDED_NAMES]

def main() -> None:
    output_path = REPO_ROOT / "project_source_code.txt"
    print(f"Merging {len(ALL_FILES)} files into {output_path.name} ...")
    
    try:
        with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f_out:
            for i, f in enumerate(ALL_FILES, 1):
                rel = f.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)
                print(f"  [{i:3d}/{len(ALL_FILES)}] {rel}")
                
                try:
                    content = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                    f_out.write("=" * 80 + "\n")
                    f_out.write(f"FILE: {rel}\n")
                    f_out.write("=" * 80 + "\n\n")
                    f_out.write(content)
                    f_out.write("\n\n")
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(f"  WARNING: {rel}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                    
        size_kb = output_path.stat().st_size / 1024
        print(f"\nDone: {output_path} ({size_kb:.1f} KB)")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ERROR: Failed to write output file: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  ФАЙЛ: ./tools/precommit_check.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pre-commit quality gate for Master-Report.

Cross-platform replacement for the old bash hook. Invoked by
.git/hooks/pre-commit (a thin sh wrapper). Does three things:

1. ruff --select F401 --fix  : auto-remove unused imports, re-staged by caller
2. ruff full check           : blocks on lint errors
3. mypy baseline mode        : blocks only NEW errors (line numbers
                               normalised, so pure line-shifts don't count)

The baseline file is .mypy_baseline.txt at the repo root. If it is
missing the first run captures it and allows the commit.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "APP"
TEST_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "tests"
BASELINE = REPO_ROOT / ".mypy_baseline.txt"


def _python() -> str:
    """Prefer the project venv python; fall back to the invoking python."""
    venv_py = REPO_ROOT / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"
    if venv_py.exists():
        return str(venv_py)
    return sys.executable


def _run(cmd: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")


def _normalise(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Strip line numbers so a pure shift from editing nearby code is
    not counted as a new error."""
    import re

    out = set()
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        line = re.sub(r":\d+:", ":N:", line)
        out.add(line)
    return out


def main() -> int:
    py = _python()

    print("=== [1/3] ruff: auto-fix unused imports ===")
    _run([py, "-m", "ruff", "check", "--select", "F401", "--fix",
          str(APP_DIR), str(TEST_DIR)])
    # The caller re-stages; we don't touch git here to stay testable.

    print("=== [2/3] ruff: full check ===")
    ruff = _run([py, "-m", "ruff", "check", str(APP_DIR), str(TEST_DIR)])
    print(ruff.stdout, end="")
    print(ruff.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
    if ruff.returncode != 0:
        print("[pre-commit] ruff failed.")
        return ruff.returncode

    print("=== [3/3] mypy: baseline mode ===")
    mypy = _run([py, "-m", "mypy", str(APP_DIR),
                 "--ignore-missing-imports", "--strict", "--no-error-summary"])
    current_lines = _normalise(mypy.stdout + mypy.stderr)

    if not BASELINE.exists():
        BASELINE.write_text(
            mypy.stdout + mypy.stderr, encoding="utf-8"
        )
        print(f"Baseline created: {BASELINE} ({len(current_lines)} issues)")
        print("No errors blocked — baseline captured.")
        print("\n=== All pre-commit checks passed ===")
        return 0

    baseline_lines = _normalise(BASELINE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    new = sorted(current_lines - baseline_lines)
    if new:
        print("=== BLOCKED: new mypy errors (line numbers normalised) ===")
        for line in new:
            print(line)
        print(
            "\nFix the above, or refresh the baseline if intentional:\n"
            f"  {py} -m mypy APP --strict --ignore-missing-imports "
            "--no-error-summary > .mypy_baseline.txt"
        )
        return 1

    print(f"mypy: no new errors (baseline: {len(baseline_lines)} lines)")
    print("\n=== All pre-commit checks passed ===")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run end-to-end tests for key user flows: Consolidation, RSCH report, and Reconciliation."""
import sys
import os
import threading
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# Add APP dir to PATH
app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "APP"
if str(app_root) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(app_root))

from core.bootstrap import Bootstrap

def test_flows():
    print("Initializing AppController via Bootstrap...")
    cfg_ctl, app_ctl, db = Bootstrap.setup(app_root, str(app_root / "config.yaml"))
    
    target_date_str = "01.04.2026"
    target_date = datetime.strptime(target_date_str, "%d.%m.%Y")
    
    # Resolve source paths from configuration
    rsch_cfg = cfg_ctl.config.get("rsch", {})
    recent_sources = [Path(p) for p in rsch_cfg.get("recent_sources", [])]
    output_dir = Path(rsch_cfg.get("last_output_dir", str(app_root.parent / "РСЧ")))
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    rsch_output_path = output_dir / f"РСЧ_отчет_{target_date_str}.xlsx"
    reconciliation_output_path = output_dir / f"Сверка_{target_date_str}.xlsx"
    
    # 1. Test Consolidation for Day
    print(f"\n--- Flow 1: Running Consolidation for {target_date_str} ---")
    done_event = threading.Event()
    results = {}
    
    def on_consolidation_comp(ok, msg, path):
        results["consolidation"] = (ok, msg, path)
        done_event.set()
        
    app_ctl.run_consolidation(
        target_date,
        on_progress=lambda p: None,
        on_complete=on_consolidation_comp
    )
    done_event.wait(timeout=120)
    print("Consolidation complete:", results["consolidation"])
    assert results["consolidation"][0], f"Consolidation failed: {results['consolidation'][1]}"
    
    # 2. Test RSCH Report Generation
    print(f"\n--- Flow 2: Generating RSCH Report for {target_date_str} ---")
    done_event.clear()
    
    def on_rsch_comp(ok, msg, path):
        results["rsch"] = (ok, msg, path)
        done_event.set()
        
    app_ctl.run_rsch_report(
        recent_sources,
        rsch_output_path,
        target_date,
        on_complete=on_rsch_comp
    )
    done_event.wait(timeout=120)
    print("RSCH report complete:", results["rsch"])
    assert results["rsch"][0], f"RSCH report failed: {results['rsch'][1]}"
    
    # 3. Test Auto-Reconciliation Day
    print(f"\n--- Flow 3: Running Auto-Reconciliation for {target_date_str} ---")
    done_event.clear()
    
    def on_reconciliation_comp(ok, msg, path):
        results["reconciliation"] = (ok, msg, path)
        done_event.set()
        
    app_ctl.run_auto_reconciliation_day(
        recent_sources,
        reconciliation_output_path,
        target_date,
        on_complete=on_reconciliation_comp
    )
    done_event.wait(timeout=120)
    print("Reconciliation complete:", results["reconciliation"])
    assert results["reconciliation"][0], f"Reconciliation failed: {results['reconciliation'][1]}"
    
    # Cleanup / Shutdown
    print("\nShutting down controllers...")
    app_ctl.shutdown()
    print("All tests passed successfully!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_flows()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"TEST FAILURE: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

param(
    [string]$RepoOwner = "sunil123456897",
    [string]$RepoName = "Exel_otchet",
    [string]$Branch = "main",
    # Pin a specific commit SHA for integrity verification. When set,
    # the updater ABORTS if the fetched commit does not match the pin —
    # this stops a compromised repository (or MITM with a valid TLS
    # cert) from pushing arbitrary code to user PCs. Empty = accept
    # branch HEAD (LESS SECURE — only use during development).
    # Bumping the pin requires manual review of the diff between the
    # old and new SHA on github.com/<owner>/<repo>/compare/<old>...<new>.
    [string]$PinnedCommitSha = "",
    [switch]$Launch
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$env:PIP_NO_KEYRING = "1"
$env:PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK = "1"
$env:PIP_NO_INPUT = "1"

try {
    [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Could not force TLS 1.2 for GitHub downloads: $($_.Exception.Message)"
}

$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $ScriptDir
$LogFile = Join-Path $Root "update_log.txt"
$StateDir = Join-Path $Root ".update_state"
$BackupRoot = Join-Path $Root ".update_backups"
$LocalSettings = @("APP\config.yaml", "APP\employees.yaml")
$LocalData = @(
    "APP\cache.db",

)

    "APP\output",

)

)

function Get-GitHubToken {
    $tokenFile = Join-Path $Root ".github_token"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokenFile) {
        $token = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $tokenFile -Raw).Trim()
        if ($token) { return $token }
    }
    $envToken = $env:GITHUB_TOKEN
    if ($envToken) { return $envToken }
    return $null
}

function Get-GitHubHeaders {
    param([string]$Token)
    $headers = @{"User-Agent" = "Master-Report-Updater"}
    if ($Token) {
        $headers["Authorization"] = "token $Token"
    }
    return $headers
}

function Write-Log {
    param([string]$Message)
    $line = "[{0}] {1}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Message
    Write-Host $Message
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
}

function Ensure-Directory {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path | Out-Null
    }
}

function Normalize-RelativePath {
    param([string]$Path)
    return (($Path -replace "/", "\").TrimEnd("\")).ToLowerInvariant()
}

function Test-IsSameOrChildPath {
    param(
        [string]$Candidate,
        [string]$Parent
    )

    $candidateNorm = Normalize-RelativePath $Candidate
    $parentNorm = Normalize-RelativePath $Parent
    return $candidateNorm -eq $parentNorm -or $candidateNorm.StartsWith($parentNorm + "\")
}

function Test-IsProtectedByUpdateItem {
    param(
        [string]$ProtectedPath,
        [string]$UpdateItem
    )

    return (Test-IsSameOrChildPath $ProtectedPath $UpdateItem) -or (Test-IsSameOrChildPath $UpdateItem $ProtectedPath)
}

function Assert-UpdatePolicy {
    foreach ($item in $UpdateItems) {
        $normalized = Normalize-RelativePath $item
        if ($normalized -in @(".", "app", "reports", "рсч", "рсч всех")) {
            throw "Небезопасный update allowlist item: $item"
        }

        foreach ($protectedPath in $ProtectedUpdatePaths) {
            if (Test-IsProtectedByUpdateItem $protectedPath $item) {
                throw "Update item '$item' пересекается с локальными данными '$protectedPath'"
            }
        }
    }
}

function Backup-LocalFiles {
    param([string[]]$RelativePaths)

    $stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $BackupRoot $stamp
    Ensure-Directory $backupDir

    foreach ($relativePath in $RelativePaths) {
        $source = Join-Path $Root $relativePath
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source) {
            $target = Join-Path $backupDir $relativePath
            Ensure-Directory (Split-Path -Parent $target)
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $target -Force
        }
    }

    return $backupDir
}

function Restore-LocalFiles {
    param(
        [string]$BackupDir,
        [string[]]$RelativePaths
    )

    foreach ($relativePath in $RelativePaths) {
        $source = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source) {
            $target = Join-Path $Root $relativePath
            Ensure-Directory (Split-Path -Parent $target)
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $target -Force
        }
    }
}

function Get-GitCommand {
    $cmd = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $cmd) {
        return $null
    }
    return $cmd.Source
}

function Get-RemoteSha {
    param([string]$Token)
    $apiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/$RepoOwner/$RepoName/commits/$Branch"
    try {
        $headers = Get-GitHubHeaders $Token
        $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $apiUrl -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30
        return [string]$response.sha
    } catch {
        Write-Log "Не удалось проверить последнюю версию через GitHub API: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        return $null
    }
}

function Get-InstalledSha {
    param([string]$FallbackSha)

    $lastShaFile = Join-Path $StateDir "last_sha.txt"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lastShaFile) {
        $storedSha = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $lastShaFile -Raw).Trim()
        if ($storedSha) {
            return $storedSha
        }
    }

    return $FallbackSha
}

function Assert-PinnedCommit {
    param([string]$ResolvedSha)

    # Integrity gate: refuse to apply an update whose commit SHA does not
    # match the operator-pinned value. Without this check, a compromised
    # GitHub repo (or a TLS-MITM with a valid cert) could push arbitrary
    # code to every user PC running ОБНОВИТЬ_И_ЗАПУСТИТЬ.bat.
    if (-not $PinnedCommitSha) {
        Write-Warning "PinnedCommitSha не задан — обновление из ветки '$Branch' без проверки целостности. Задайте -PinnedCommitSha для защиты от компрометации репозитория."
        return
    }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ResolvedSha)) {
        throw "Не удалось определить SHA загруженного коммита. Обновление отменено (нет целостности)."
    }
    $resolvedNorm = $ResolvedSha.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
    $pinnedNorm = $PinnedCommitSha.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($resolvedNorm -ne $pinnedNorm) {
        throw "Целостность обновления НЕ подтверждена: полученный commit '$resolvedNorm' не совпадает с закреплённым '$pinnedNorm'. Обновление ОТМЕНЕНО. Для обновления пина вручную проверьте diff на github.com/$RepoOwner/$RepoName/compare/$pinnedNorm...$resolvedNorm и обновите -PinnedCommitSha."
    }
}

function Copy-UpdateItems {
    param([string]$SourceRoot)

    foreach ($item in $UpdateItems) {
        $source = Join-Path $SourceRoot $item
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source)) {
            Write-Log "Пропускаю отсутствующий файл обновления: $item"
            continue
        }

        $target = Join-Path $Root $item
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source -PathType Container) {
            Ensure-Directory $target
            Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $source -Force | Copy-Item -Destination $target -Recurse -Force
        } else {
            Ensure-Directory (Split-Path -Parent $target)
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $target -Force
        }
    }
}

function Expand-GitArchive {
    param(
        [string]$Git,
        [string]$Treeish,
        [string]$Destination
    )

    Ensure-Directory $Destination
    $archivePath = Join-Path $Destination "update.tar"
    $normalizedItems = $UpdateItems | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace "\\", "/" }

    & $Git archive --format=tar --output=$archivePath $Treeish -- $normalizedItems
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "git archive завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
    }

    tar -xf $archivePath -C $Destination
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "tar завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

function Update-WithGit {
    param([string]$Git, [string]$Token)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Root ".git"))) {
        return $false
    }

    Push-Location $Root
    try {
        $remoteUrl = & $Git remote get-url origin 2>$null
        if (-not $remoteUrl) {
            if ($Token) {
                & $Git remote add origin "https://$Token@github.com/$RepoOwner/$RepoName.git" | Out-Null
            } else {
                & $Git remote add origin "https://github.com/$RepoOwner/$RepoName.git" | Out-Null
            }
        } elseif ($Token -and $remoteUrl -notmatch "@github\.com") {
            & $Git remote set-url origin "https://$Token@github.com/$RepoOwner/$RepoName.git" | Out-Null
        }

        Write-Log "Проверяю обновления через Git..."
        & $Git fetch origin $Branch --quiet
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "git fetch завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
        }

        $headSha = (& $Git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
        $localSha = Get-InstalledSha $headSha
        $remoteSha = (& $Git rev-parse "origin/$Branch").Trim()
        Assert-PinnedCommit $remoteSha
        if ($localSha -eq $remoteSha) {
            Write-Log "Новых версий нет. Текущая версия: $localSha"
            return $true
        }

        $backupDir = Backup-LocalFiles ($LocalSettings + $LocalData)
        Write-Log "Найдена новая версия: $remoteSha. Backup локальных настроек/БД: $backupDir"

        $tempDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("master_report_git_update_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
        try {
            Expand-GitArchive $Git "origin/$Branch" $tempDir
            Copy-UpdateItems $tempDir
        } finally {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tempDir) {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempDir -Recurse -Force
            }
        }

        Restore-LocalFiles $backupDir ($LocalSettings + $LocalData)
        Ensure-Directory $StateDir
        Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $StateDir "last_sha.txt") -Value $remoteSha -Encoding UTF8
        Write-Log "Минимальное обновление через Git выполнено. Локальные настройки/БД возвращены."
        return $true
    } catch {
        Write-Log "WARNING: Git update failed: $($_.Exception.Message). Falling back to snapshot update..."
        return $false
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
}

function Update-WithGitSnapshot {
    param([string]$Git)

    $tempRepo = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("master_report_git_snapshot_repo_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
    $tempArchive = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("master_report_git_snapshot_update_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
    $pushed = $false

    try {
        Ensure-Directory $tempRepo
        Ensure-Directory $tempArchive
        Push-Location $tempRepo
        $pushed = $true

        try {
            & $Git init --quiet
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                throw "git init завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
            }

            & $Git remote add origin "https://github.com/$RepoOwner/$RepoName.git"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                throw "git remote add завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
            }

            Write-Log "Папка без .git. Скачиваю минимальный snapshot через Git..."
            & $Git fetch --depth=1 origin $Branch --quiet
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                throw "git fetch snapshot завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
            }

            $remoteSha = (& $Git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD).Trim()
            Assert-PinnedCommit $remoteSha
            $localSha = Get-InstalledSha ""
            if ($localSha -eq $remoteSha) {
                Write-Log "Новых версий нет. Текущая версия: $localSha"
                return $true
            }

            $backupDir = Backup-LocalFiles ($LocalSettings + $LocalData)
            Write-Log "Найдена новая версия: $remoteSha. Backup локальных настроек/БД: $backupDir"

            Expand-GitArchive $Git "FETCH_HEAD" $tempArchive
            Copy-UpdateItems $tempArchive
            Restore-LocalFiles $backupDir ($LocalSettings + $LocalData)
            Ensure-Directory $StateDir
            Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $StateDir "last_sha.txt") -Value $remoteSha -Encoding UTF8
            Write-Log "Минимальное обновление через Git snapshot выполнено. Локальные настройки/БД возвращены."
            return $true
        } catch {
            Write-Log "WARNING: Git snapshot update failed: $($_.Exception.Message). Falling back to zip update..."
            return $false
        }
    } finally {
        if ($pushed) {
            Pop-Location
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tempArchive) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempArchive -Recurse -Force
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tempRepo) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRepo -Recurse -Force
        }
    }
}

function Update-WithZip {
    param([string]$Token)
    $remoteSha = Get-RemoteSha $Token
    Assert-PinnedCommit $remoteSha
    $lastShaFile = Join-Path $StateDir "last_sha.txt"
    if ($remoteSha -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lastShaFile)) {
        $currentSha = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $lastShaFile -Raw).Trim()
        if ($currentSha -eq $remoteSha) {
            Write-Log "Новых версий нет. Текущая версия: $currentSha"
            return
        }
    }

    $backupDir = Backup-LocalFiles ($LocalSettings + $LocalData)
    $tempDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("master_report_update_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
    $zipPath = Join-Path $tempDir "source.zip"
    Ensure-Directory $tempDir

    try {
        if ($Token) {
            $zipUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/$RepoOwner/$RepoName/zipball/$Branch"
            $headers = Get-GitHubHeaders $Token
            $headers["Accept"] = "application/vnd.github+json"
        } else {
            $zipUrl = "https://github.com/$RepoOwner/$RepoName/archive/refs/heads/$Branch.zip"
            $headers = Get-GitHubHeaders $Token
        }
        Write-Log "Git не найден или папка без .git. Скачиваю zip из GitHub..."
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $zipUrl -OutFile $zipPath -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120 -Headers $headers
        Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zipPath -DestinationPath $tempDir -Force
        $sourceRoot = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $tempDir -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "$RepoName-*" -or $_.Name -like "$RepoOwner-$RepoName-*" } | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($null -eq $sourceRoot) {
            throw "Не найдена распакованная папка проекта."
        }

        Copy-UpdateItems $sourceRoot.FullName

        Restore-LocalFiles $backupDir ($LocalSettings + $LocalData)
        Ensure-Directory $StateDir
        if ($remoteSha) {
            Set-Content -LiteralPath $lastShaFile -Value $remoteSha -Encoding UTF8
        }
        Write-Log "Минимальное обновление через zip выполнено. Локальные настройки/БД возвращены."
    } finally {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tempDir) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempDir -Recurse -Force
        }
    }
}

function Update-Dependencies {
    $venvPython = Join-Path $Root ".venv\Scripts\python.exe"
    $requirements = Join-Path $Root "requirements.txt"
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $venvPython) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $requirements)) {
        $size = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $venvPython).Length
        $valid = $false
        if ($size -gt 10000) {
            $null = & $venvPython --version 2>$null
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
                $valid = $true
            }
        }
        if ($valid) {
            Write-Log "Обновляю зависимости в локальном .venv..."
            & $venvPython -m pip install -r $requirements | Tee-Object -FilePath $LogFile -Append
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                throw "pip install завершился с кодом $LASTEXITCODE"
            }
        } else {
            Write-Warning "Локальное виртуальное окружение .venv неисправно. Пропускаю обновление зависимостей в апдейтере. ЗАПУСК.bat автоматически пересоздаст окружение."
        }
    }
}

Set-Content -Path $LogFile -Value "" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Log "Master Report updater started."
Write-Log "Project folder: $Root"
Assert-UpdatePolicy

$gitHubToken = Get-GitHubToken
if ($gitHubToken) {
    Write-Log "GitHub токен найден. Используется авторизованный доступ."
} else {
    Write-Log "GitHub токен не найден. Попытка анонимного доступа..."
}

$git = Get-GitCommand
$updatedWithGit = $false
if ($git) {
    $updatedWithGit = Update-WithGit $git
    if (-not $updatedWithGit) {
        $updatedWithGit = Update-WithGitSnapshot $git
    }
}
if (-not $updatedWithGit) {
    Update-WithZip $gitHubToken
}

Update-Dependencies

if ($Launch) {
    $launcher = Join-Path $Root "ЗАПУСК.bat"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher)) {
        throw "Не найден ЗАПУСК.bat"
    }
    Write-Log "Запускаю приложение..."
    Start-Process -FilePath $launcher -ArgumentList "/nopause" -WorkingDirectory $Root
}

Write-Log "Updater finished successfully."

  ФАЙЛ: ./ЗАПУСК.bat
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

﻿@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions
chcp 65001 >nul

set "PIP_NO_KEYRING=1"
set "PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1"
set "PIP_NO_INPUT=1"

set "ARG1=%~1"
set "ARG2=%~2"

title Master Report Launcher v5.5

set "APPDIR=%~dp0APP"
set "MAINFILE=%APPDIR%\main.py"
set "LOGFILE=%~dp0startup_log.txt"
set "GUIERRLOG=%~dp0gui_error_log.txt"
set "TARGET_PY=3.12"
set "VENV_DIR=%~dp0.venv"
set "FAIL_MESSAGE="

set "PYTHON_CMD="
set "PYTHONW_CMD="
set "PYTHON_IS_VENV="

:: Clean up inherited environment variables if they contain empty quotes or invalid placeholders
if "%PYTHON_CMD%"=="""" set "PYTHON_CMD="
if "%PYTHON_CMD%"=="""""" set "PYTHON_CMD="
if "%PYTHONW_CMD%"=="""" set "PYTHONW_CMD="
if "%PYTHONW_CMD%"=="""""" set "PYTHONW_CMD="

break > "%LOGFILE%"
break > "%GUIERRLOG%"

call :log "========================================================"
call :log "MASTER REPORT CONSOLIDATOR v5.5"
call :log "========================================================"
call :log "Start time: %date% %time%"

echo ========================================================
echo MASTER REPORT CONSOLIDATOR v5.5
echo ========================================================
echo.
echo Checking environment...

if not exist "%MAINFILE%" goto missing_main

if not exist "%~dp0requirements.txt" goto missing_requirements

cd /d "%APPDIR%"
if errorlevel 1 goto appdir_unavailable

call :step "Step 1/5. Finding Python"
call :refresh_paths
call :find_python

if not defined PYTHON_CMD goto python_not_found
if "%PYTHON_CMD%"=="""" goto python_not_found
if "%PYTHON_CMD%"=="""""" goto python_not_found
goto python_ok

:python_not_found
call :log "Python not found. Install it from python.org"
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=Python not found. Please install Python 3.10 or newer and make sure it is in PATH."
goto fail

:python_ok

call :step "Step 2/5. Checking pip"
"%PYTHON_CMD%" -m pip --version >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 goto pip_ok
call :log "pip missing. Repairing..."
"%PYTHON_CMD%" -m ensurepip --upgrade >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 goto pip_repair_failed

:pip_ok

call :step "Step 3/5. Checking packaging tools"
"%PYTHON_CMD%" -m pip --version >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 goto tool_upgrade_failed

call :step "Step 4/5. Checking libraries"
"%PYTHON_CMD%" -c "import tkinter, openpyxl, yaml, ruamel.yaml, tkcalendar, pyxlsb, pydantic, python_calamine" >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 goto install_requirements
goto after_requirements

:install_requirements
call :log "Installing missing libraries..."
if defined PYTHON_IS_VENV (
    "%PYTHON_CMD%" -m pip install -r "%~dp0requirements.txt" >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
) else (
    call :log "WARNING: local .venv is unavailable; installing into user site-packages."
    "%PYTHON_CMD%" -m pip install --user -r "%~dp0requirements.txt" >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
)
if errorlevel 1 goto requirements_install_failed

:after_requirements

call :step "Step 4.5/5. GUI import preflight"
"%PYTHON_CMD%" -c "import main; main.preflight_gui_imports()" >> "%GUIERRLOG%" 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 goto gui_ok
call :log "GUI preflight failed. See gui_error_log.txt"
goto gui_preflight_failed

:gui_ok

call :step "Step 5/5. Launching application"
if not defined PYTHONW_CMD goto start_python
call :log "Launching via pythonw (no console)"
start "" "%PYTHONW_CMD%" "%MAINFILE%"
goto launch_done

:start_python
call :log "Launching via python (with console)"
start "" "%PYTHON_CMD%" "%MAINFILE%"

:launch_done

echo.
echo -------------------------------------------------------
echo DONE. The application is starting...
echo This window will close automatically in 3 seconds.
echo -------------------------------------------------------
timeout /t 3 >nul
exit /b 0


:step
echo %~1
call :log "%~1"
exit /b 0

:log
>> "%LOGFILE%" echo [%date% %time%] %~1
exit /b 0

:fail
echo.
echo [ERROR] %FAIL_MESSAGE%
call :log "[ERROR] %FAIL_MESSAGE%"
if not "%ARG1%"=="/nopause" if not "%ARG2%"=="/nopause" pause
exit /b 1

:missing_main
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=main.py was not found inside APP."
goto fail

:missing_requirements
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=requirements.txt was not found next to the launcher. Copy the whole project, not just APP."
goto fail

:appdir_unavailable
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=Could not switch into the APP directory."
goto fail

:pip_repair_failed
if exist "%LOGFILE%" type "%LOGFILE%"
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=Could not repair pip."
goto fail

:tool_upgrade_failed
if exist "%LOGFILE%" type "%LOGFILE%"
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=Could not update pip/setuptools/wheel."
goto fail

:requirements_install_failed
if exist "%LOGFILE%" type "%LOGFILE%"
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=Could not install dependencies from requirements.txt."
goto fail

:gui_preflight_failed
if exist "%GUIERRLOG%" type "%GUIERRLOG%"
set "FAIL_MESSAGE=GUI startup failed."
goto fail

:refresh_paths
set "PATH=%PATH%;%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps;%LocalAppData%\Programs\Python\Launcher"
exit /b 0

:find_python
rem 1. Prefer an isolated local virtual environment next to the launcher.
if exist "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\python.exe" (
    call :check_venv_valid
    if not errorlevel 1 (
        set "PYTHON_CMD=%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\python.exe"
        set "PYTHON_IS_VENV=1"
        if exist "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe" set "PYTHONW_CMD=%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe"
        goto python_launcher_done
    )
    call :log "WARNING: Local .venv is broken (likely copied from another PC). Re-creating..."
    call :cleanup_broken_venv
)

rem 2. Try to create the local virtual environment using different Python handles.
rem Try py -3.12 first
py -%TARGET_PY% --version >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 (
    call :log "Creating local virtual environment using py -%TARGET_PY%: %VENV_DIR%"
    py -%TARGET_PY% -m venv "%VENV_DIR%" >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
    goto check_created_venv
)

rem Try py launcher generally
py --version >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 (
    call :log "Creating local virtual environment using py: %VENV_DIR%"
    py -m venv "%VENV_DIR%" >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
    goto check_created_venv
)

rem Try python in PATH
python --version >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 (
    call :log "Creating local virtual environment using python: %VENV_DIR%"
    python -m venv "%VENV_DIR%" >> "%LOGFILE%" 2>&1
    goto check_created_venv
)

:check_created_venv
if exist "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\python.exe" (
    call :check_venv_valid
    if not errorlevel 1 (
        set "PYTHON_CMD=%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\python.exe"
        set "PYTHON_IS_VENV=1"
        if exist "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe" set "PYTHONW_CMD=%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe"
        goto python_launcher_done
    )
)
call :log "WARNING: could not create local .venv; falling back to PATH Python."

rem 3. Fallback to regular python in PATH
for /f "delims=" %%I in ('where python 2^>nul') do (
    if not defined PYTHON_CMD set "PYTHON_CMD=%%~fI"
)
for /f "delims=" %%I in ('where pythonw 2^>nul') do (
    if not defined PYTHONW_CMD set "PYTHONW_CMD=%%~fI"
)

rem 4. Last fallback to py launcher directly
if defined PYTHON_CMD goto python_launcher_done
py --version >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 (
    set "PYTHON_CMD=py"
    set "PYTHONW_CMD=pyw"
)

:python_launcher_done
exit /b 0

:cleanup_broken_venv
set "TEMP_VENV=%VENV_DIR%_broken_%RANDOM%"
move "%VENV_DIR%" "%TEMP_VENV%" >nul 2>&1
if exist "%VENV_DIR%" rd /s /q "%VENV_DIR%" >nul 2>&1
if exist "%TEMP_VENV%" rd /s /q "%TEMP_VENV%" >nul 2>&1
exit /b 0

:check_venv_valid
for %%I in ("%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\python.exe") do (
    if %%~zI LSS 10000 exit /b 1
)
"%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\python.exe" --version >nul 2>&1
exit /b %errorlevel%

  ФАЙЛ: ./ОБНОВИТЬ_И_ЗАПУСТИТЬ.bat
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

﻿@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions
chcp 65001 >nul

title Master Report Updater

set "ROOT=%~dp0"
set "SCRIPT=%ROOT%tools\update_from_github.ps1"
set "POWERSHELL_CMD=powershell"

if not exist "%SCRIPT%" (
    echo [ERROR] Updater not found: %SCRIPT%
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

where pwsh >nul 2>&1
if not errorlevel 1 set "POWERSHELL_CMD=pwsh"

"%POWERSHELL_CMD%" -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%SCRIPT%" -Launch
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Update failed. See details above and in update_log.txt.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

exit /b 0
